objects.definition:
typedef enum _SOPC_ReturnStatus
{
    SOPC_STATUS_OK = 0,
    SOPC_STATUS_NOK,
    SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS,
    SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE,
    SOPC_STATUS_ENCODING_ERROR,
    SOPC_STATUS_WOULD_BLOCK,
    SOPC_STATUS_TIMEOUT,
    SOPC_STATUS_OUT_OF_MEMORY,
    SOPC_STATUS_CLOSED,
    SOPC_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED
} SOPC_ReturnStatus;
objects.description: Enumeration of return statuses used throughout S2OPC APIs. Values indicate success or various error/exceptional conditions such as invalid parameters, invalid state, encoding errors, non-blocking operations that would block, timeouts, out-of-memory, closed state, and unsupported operations.

Opaque-by-convention but publicly defined byte buffer object that tracks a data region (data) with capacity management (initial_size used as growth step for resizable buffers, current_size, maximum_size), and cursoring (position for read/write, length for current data length). Used for reading/writing bytes, printing numeric/text representations, copying between buffers, file loading, and wrap/attach of existing memory. Memory ownership of data is managed by SOPC_Buffer and freed by Clear/Delete. Unknown aspects: thread-safety and alignment guarantees are not specified.
Enumeration type representing return status codes used across the SOPC API. It is referenced via sopc_enums.h and not defined in this header. Details (values, semantics) are unknown from this file.

Built-in C string pointer type used pervasively in this header for input/output string parameters. Not defined here; included only for clarity. No custom construction semantics beyond standard C allocation/free. Note: SOPC_strdup returns a newly allocated C string that should be freed with SOPC_Free as per project conventions.
OPC UA pair of a QualifiedName key to a Variant value. Used widely for property bags and headers.
Container for an array of KeyValuePair additional parameters.
Ephemeral public key and corresponding signature blob for key exchange.
Simple endpoint info: URL, security mode/policy and transport profile.
Signed rational number with 32-bit numerator and unsigned 32-bit denominator.
3D vector (X,Y,Z) in doubles.
3D Cartesian coordinates identical layout to ThreeDVector.
3D orientation angles (A,B,C), convention per OPC UA 3D model (likely Euler).
Pose frame composed of 3D cartesian coordinates and orientation.
Rule describing how to map external identity to an OPC UA role/profile.
Represents an ISO currency (numeric and alphabetic codes), exponent and display name.
PKI trust list content: arrays of certs and CRLs for trusted and issuer lists; SpecifiedLists bitmask selects which are present.
Arbitrary precision decimal represented as binary magnitude (Value) and base-10 scale.
Describes a field within a StructureDefinition: name, datatype, rank/array dims, max string length, optionality.

Named structure datatype description bound to a DataType NodeId and full StructureDefinition.
Enumeration literal description: integer value, name and localized texts.

PubSub configuration for event publishing: notifier node, selected fields and event filter.
Writer configuration for a DataSet in PubSub including IDs, field mask, keyframe, properties and transport/message settings.

Writer group configuration including timing, security key services, properties, transport/message settings and DataSet writers.

Reader group configuration including arrays of DataSetReaderDataType and common group properties.

Broker transport settings for DataSet writer including metadata topic and update time.
Broker transport settings for DataSet reader.

Identifies a node attribute to read, with optional array range and data encoding.

No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. It only declares preprocessor macros for versioning (major/medium/minor) and helpers to stringify/quote them, plus a composite SOPC_TOOLKIT_VERSION macro.

Opaque forward-declared, then fully defined client configuration object for the S2OPC toolkit. Holds application description, locale preferences, certificate/key/PKI, and an array of secure connection configurations plus optional reverse endpoint URLs. Lifecycle controlled by SOPC_ClientConfig_Initialize/Clear. Strings and arrays may be freed by toolkit when freeCstringsFlag is true.

Configuration parameters for a Secure Channel (client or server). Includes endpoint URL, expected endpoints for validation, requested security policy and mode, lifetime, peer certificate holder, and audit info. internalProtocolData is toolkit-internal and set during connection.
Endpoint security policy configuration entry, listing a SecurityPolicy URI, supported message security modes (bitmask), and the set of user token policies supported for that endpoint.

Opaque forward-declared, then fully defined server configuration object for the S2OPC toolkit. Aggregates application description, locale support, certificate/key/PKI, endpoint configurations, method call manager, optional callbacks for monitored item availability and request overwrite, and user authZ/authN managers.
Server-side reverse connection target configuration: identifies a client by ApplicationUri (optional) and the client endpoint URL to connect for reverse connect capability.

Server endpoint listener configuration, including URL, discovery endpoint presence, array of security policy configurations, and optional reverse-connection client targets. Belongs to a SOPC_Server_Config.
Client-side temporary config holding filesystem paths to a user's X.509 certificate and private key (with encryption flag) for session activation. Used to load serialized credentials.
Holds user X.509 credentials for session activation: serialized certificate, private key, and optionally a paths-based temporary configuration to load them.
Username/password credentials used for session activation with UserName token type.
Session activation configuration selecting a user token policy and carrying either username/password or X.509 credentials depending on userTokenType.
Aggregates secure channel and session configuration to define a client-side secure connection, including optional reverse URL and support for updating the server certificate from path or callback.
Client temporary paths-based configuration for loading the client certificate, private key (with encryption flag), and PKI store.

Function pointer type for a server callback used by CreateMonitoredItems when a NodeId is not yet in the address space. Returns whether it should be accepted and provides expected NodeClass and an initial Bad status for first notifications.
Function pointer type for a server callback invoked to overwrite/inspect incoming session service requests prior to processing. Must be non-blocking; returning non-good leads to a ServiceFault.
Top-level S2OPC configuration grouping both server and client configurations. Initialize and clear via SOPC_S2OPC_Config_Initialize/Clear.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t SOPC_SessionId;
objects.description: Opaque numeric identifier for a client-side session, generated on SE_ACTIVATED_SESSION events. This is an alias of uint32_t used throughout callbacks/events.

objects.definition:
typedef enum _SOPC_App_Com_Event
{
    SE_REVERSE_ENDPOINT_CLOSED = 0x700,
    SE_SESSION_ACTIVATION_FAILURE,
    SE_ACTIVATED_SESSION,
    SE_SESSION_REACTIVATING,
    SE_RCV_SESSION_RESPONSE,
    SE_CLOSED_SESSION,
    SE_CLOSED_CHANNEL,
    SE_RCV_DISCOVERY_RESPONSE,
    SE_SND_REQUEST_FAILED,

    SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT,
    SE_LOCAL_SERVICE_RESPONSE
} SOPC_App_Com_Event;
objects.description: Enumeration of application-level communication events reported by the toolkit for client and server sides. Values indicate lifecycle events, responses, failures, and closures. Used with SOPC_ComEvent_Fct callback.
Enumeration of server address space notification events. Currently only AS_WRITE_EVENT for write operations to the server address space.

objects.definition: typedef void SOPC_ComEvent_Fct(SOPC_App_Com_Event event, uint32_t IdOrStatus, void* param, uintptr_t appContext);
objects.description: Function pointer type for application callback receiving toolkit communication events with an ID/status, parameter pointer, and user context.

objects.definition:
typedef void SOPC_AddressSpaceNotif_Fct(const SOPC_CallContext* callCtxPtr,
                                        SOPC_App_AddSpace_Event event,
                                        void* opParam,
                                        SOPC_StatusCode opStatus);
objects.description: Function pointer type for server address space notification callbacks, providing call context, event kind, operation parameter, and status code.
Structure containing toolkit build information: common build metadata and client/server-specific build metadata.

objects.definition:
typedef struct SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg
{
    SOPC_ReverseEndpointConfigIdx
        reverseEndpointConfigIdx; /*<< Index of the Reverse Endpoint configuration to listen for server connection
                                       returned by ::SOPC_ToolkitClient_AddReverseEndpointConfig().
                                       It shall be 0 for a classic connection and > 0 for a reverse connection. */
    SOPC_SecureChannelConfigIdx
        secureChannelConfigIdx; /*<< Index of the Secure Channel configuration for endpoint connection
                                     returned by ::SOPC_ToolkitClient_AddSecureChannelConfig().
                                     It shall not be 0. */
} SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg;
objects.description: Endpoint connection configuration value type used by the client APIs to describe how to connect to a server endpoint, either in classic mode (client-initiated, reverseEndpointConfigIdx == 0) or reverse connection mode (server-initiated, reverseEndpointConfigIdx > 0). It carries indices to previously configured reverse-endpoint and secure-channel configurations. It is a plain aggregate (not opaque) and is typically constructed via the provided helper functions.

Enumeration of supported OPC UA Security Policy identifiers usable with endpoint or client secure connection configuration. Values correspond to specific OPC UA security policy URIs. Construction is implicit (plain enum).

objects.definition: typedef struct SOPC_ConfigClientXML_Custom SOPC_ConfigClientXML_Custom;
objects.description: Opaque forward-declared struct reserved for future customization when configuring a client from XML (e.g., alternative PKI provider). Only an incomplete declaration is provided here; the layout and members are unknown in this header.

objects.definition: typedef void SOPC_ServiceAsyncResp_Fct(SOPC_EncodeableType* type, const void* response, uintptr_t userContext);
objects.description: Function type for asynchronous service response callbacks used by the client helper. Implementations receive the encodeable type (or NULL on send failure), a pointer to the service response structure (or NULL on send failure), and an opaque user context. Register with SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetServiceAsyncResponse.

Function type to provide username and password for session activation when using a username token. The implementation must allocate and return zero-terminated username and password on success; on failure it must free and reset the out parameters to NULL. Register with SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetUserNamePasswordCallback.

Function type to provide the password for decrypting the user X509 token private key identified by the provided certificate thumbprint. On success, allocate and return a zero-terminated password; on failure, free and reset the out parameter to NULL. Register with SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetUserKeyPasswordCallback.

objects.definition: typedef bool SOPC_GetPassword_Fct(char** outPassword);
objects.description: Generic function type to provide a password (e.g., for decrypting the client application private key or user X509 token private key). On success, allocate and return a zero-terminated password; on failure, free and reset the out parameter to NULL. Register with SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetClientKeyPasswordCallback.

Opaque secure connection configuration type referenced throughout this header. It is not defined here (only used), so its structure and ownership rules are unknown in this file. Instances are created and owned by the library; callers obtain pointers via helper APIs and must not free them directly.

objects.definition: typedef struct SOPC_ClientConnection SOPC_ClientConnection;
objects.description: Opaque client-side handle representing a secure connection (SecureChannel + Session) to an OPC UA server. Only a forward declaration is provided here; the structure is defined privately in the library and must be managed through the helper API.

objects.definition:
typedef enum
{
    SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent_Disconnected, /**< Connection terminated unexpectedly, it will not be established again
                                                unless a new connection attempt is done. To do a new attempt the
                                                following functions shall be called:
                                                - ::SOPC_ClientHelper_Disconnect on current connection
                                                - ::SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect to create a new connection
                                              */
    SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent_Connected,    /**< (NOT IMPLEMENTED YET) Connection established (SC & session), only
                                                triggered when asynchronous SOPC_ClientHelper_StartConnection is used
                                                or in case of reconnection.
                                              */
    SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent_Reconnecting, /**< (NOT IMPLEMENTED YET) Connection temporarily interrupted,
                                                  attempt to re-establish connection on-going.
                                                  Do not use connection until Connected event received */
} SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent;
objects.description: Enumeration of connection lifecycle events delivered to the client connection event callback. Indicates disconnection, connection, or reconnection states. Note: some values are marked not implemented yet.
Function type (callback) invoked on client connection events. Must be non-blocking. Receives the concerned connection, the event, and a status code.

objects.definition: typedef struct SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription;
objects.description: Opaque handle representing a client-side subscription associated to a secure connection. Only a forward declaration is provided here; actual structure is private to the library. Create and manage via the subscription helper API.

objects.definition:
typedef void SOPC_ClientSubscriptionNotification_Fct(const SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* subscription,
                                                     SOPC_StatusCode status,
                                                     SOPC_EncodeableType* notificationType,
                                                     uint32_t nbNotifElts,
                                                     const void* notification,
                                                     uintptr_t* monitoredItemCtxArray);
objects.description: Function type (callback) invoked on subscription notifications (data change or event). Must be non-blocking. Provides the subscription, operation status, encodeable type of the notification, number of elements, the notification payload, and the array of user contexts per monitored item.

objects.definition: typedef struct SOPC_ConfigServerXML_Custom SOPC_ConfigServerXML_Custom;
objects.description: Forward-declared (incomplete) struct reserved for future customization of server configuration via XML (e.g., custom PKI provider). No fields are defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef bool SOPC_GetServerKeyPassword_Fct(char** outPassword);
objects.description: Function type for a callback that returns a newly allocated zero-terminated password string to decrypt the server private key. The implementer must free outPassword and reset it to NULL on failure.

objects.definition:
typedef void SOPC_ExternalHistoryRawRead_Fct(const OpcUa_ReadRawModifiedDetails* readRawDetails,
                                             bool sourceTsRequired,
                                             bool releaseContinuationPoint,
                                             const OpcUa_HistoryReadValueId* singleValueId,
                                             uintptr_t userContext,
                                             SOPC_StatusCode* outStatusCode,
                                             SOPC_ByteString** outContinuationPoint,
                                             int32_t* outNbDataValues,
                                             SOPC_DataValue** outDataValues);
objects.description: Function type for a callback that fetches raw historical data from an external history server. It must allocate and return data values and optionally a continuation point; the library frees returned memory after the call.
Function type for a callback notified on address-space writes. Receives context, the resulting or requested value, and the write status. Must be non-blocking.

Function type for a callback used by CreateMonitoredItems when a NodeId is not yet in the address space. Return true to accept and provide expected NodeClass and a Bad status to report in first notification; false to reject with Bad_NodeIdUnknown.

objects.definition: typedef void SOPC_LocalServiceAsyncResp_Fct(SOPC_EncodeableType* type, void* response, uintptr_t userContext);
objects.description: Function type for asynchronous local service responses initiated via SOPC_ServerHelper_LocalServiceAsync. The response points to an OPC UA response or ServiceFault. The caller frees the response after the callback returns; copy/move if needed.

Function type for a callback allowing the application to inspect/modify incoming session service requests before processing. Must be non-blocking. Return SOPC_GoodGenericStatus to proceed or a suitable Bad status (e.g., Busy/ResourceUnavailable) to force a ServiceFault.

objects.definition: typedef SOPC_SecurityPolicy SOPC_SecurityConfig;
objects.description: Alias type for an endpoint security configuration. It represents a security policy instance attached to an endpoint configuration and is completed with security modes and user token policies. Underlying concrete type is SOPC_SecurityPolicy defined elsewhere.

Bitmask enum selecting the allowed message security modes for a security configuration: None, Sign, or SignAndEncrypt. Values are intended to be ORed together. Used when configuring an SOPC_SecurityConfig.

objects.definition: typedef OpcUa_UserTokenPolicy SOPC_UserTokenPolicy;
objects.description: Alias to the OPC UA user token policy structure describing how clients authenticate (e.g., Anonymous, UserName). The concrete definition is provided elsewhere.

objects.definition: typedef void SOPC_ServerStopped_Fct(SOPC_ReturnStatus status);
objects.description: Function type for a callback invoked when the server stops. The callback receives the final SOPC_ReturnStatus (SOPC_STATUS_OK if stopped intentionally). The header warns that the callback must not perform blocking operations.

objects.definition: typedef uint32_t SOPC_FileHandle;
objects.description: Opaque handle value for an opened file instance within the File Transfer module. Generated by the server during Open and used by clients for subsequent file operations. It is a 32-bit unsigned integer identifier.

objects.definition: typedef SOPC_Byte SOPC_OpenMode;
objects.description: Bitmask indicating the requested open mode flags for a file (e.g., read/write/append semantics as defined by the server). Underlying type is SOPC_Byte.

objects.definition: typedef struct _SOPC_FileType SOPC_FileType;
objects.description: Abstract handle type representing an OPC UA FileType object managed by the File Transfer module. Structure is intentionally opaque in this header; lifecycle is managed by the module.

objects.definition: typedef struct _SOPC_FileType_Config SOPC_FileType_Config;

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Create
functions.description: Allocates a non-resizable SOPC_Buffer and its data array with a fixed size of `size` bytes. Use when the buffer capacity is known and will not grow. Returns NULL on allocation failure.
requirements: size is the exact capacity; the buffer will not grow beyond this size.
Caller must check the return value for NULL before use.
On success, the buffer must later be released with SOPC_Buffer_Delete (or at least cleared with SOPC_Buffer_Clear).

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_CreateResizable
functions.description: Allocates a resizable SOPC_Buffer with an initial capacity of `initial_size` bytes and a maximum capacity of `maximum_size` bytes. The buffer may grow in increments of `initial_size` up to `maximum_size`. Returns NULL on allocation failure.
requirements: Caller must check the return value for NULL before use.
The buffer must be released with SOPC_Buffer_Delete when no longer needed.
Inferred constraint: maximum_size should be greater than or equal to initial_size; otherwise growth semantics are undefined (not explicitly stated).

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Attach
functions.description: Wraps an existing raw memory region as an SOPC_Buffer. Ownership of `data` is transferred to the created buffer, which will free it on SOPC_Buffer_Clear or SOPC_Buffer_Delete. Returns NULL on allocation failure.
requirements: data must point to a memory region of at least `size` bytes.
After a successful call, the caller must not free or reuse `data` directly; it will be managed and freed by the SOPC_Buffer.
Caller must check the return value for NULL before use.
The returned buffer must be released with SOPC_Buffer_Delete or its data freed via SOPC_Buffer_Clear.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Clear
functions.description: Deallocates the buffer's data bytes content, leaving the SOPC_Buffer structure allocated. Use to free the data while keeping the buffer object.
requirements: buffer may be NULL only if the implementation tolerates it; otherwise pass a valid pointer (NULL behavior not specified).
After clearing, the buffer's data content is deallocated; subsequent operations that require allocated content must reinitialize or reattach data.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Delete
functions.description: Deallocates the SOPC_Buffer and its data bytes content. After this call, the pointer must not be used.
requirements: buffer should be a pointer returned by an SOPC_Buffer creation/attach function or NULL if implementation tolerates it (NULL behavior not specified).
Do not use the buffer pointer after deletion; do not double-delete.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Reset
functions.description: Resets an allocated buffer: sets length and position to zero and zeros the data bytes. Use to reuse a buffer without freeing it.
requirements: buffer must be a valid, allocated SOPC_Buffer.
Buffer data must be allocated; behavior is unspecified if content is not allocated.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_ResetAfterPosition
functions.description: Zeros data bytes from `position` onward and sets the buffer's position and length to `position`. Fails on invalid parameters.
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
position must be less than or equal to buffer->length.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK; otherwise parameters were invalid.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_GetPosition
functions.description: Retrieves the current read/write position of the buffer into `position`.
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
position must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the result.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_SetPosition
functions.description: Sets the buffer's current position to `position`. The position must not exceed the current length.
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
position must be less than or equal to buffer->length.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_SetDataLength
functions.description: Sets the buffer's data length to `length`. Length must be within capacity and not less than the current position.
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
length must be less than or equal to buffer->maximum_size.
length must be greater than or equal to buffer->position.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Write
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_Write(SOPC_Buffer* buffer, const uint8_t* data_src, uint32_t count);
functions.description: Writes `count` bytes from `data_src` into the buffer at the current position, advancing position and possibly length. May fail if the buffer is full or cannot grow to accommodate the write.
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and have allocated content (or be resizable within its maximum).
data_src must be a non-NULL pointer to at least `count` bytes.
count + buffer->position must be less than or equal to buffer->maximum_size.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK; errors include NULL pointers, non-allocated content, or insufficient capacity.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Read
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_Read(uint8_t* data_dest, SOPC_Buffer* buffer, uint32_t count);
functions.description: Reads `count` bytes from the buffer at the current position into `data_dest` and advances the position. If `data_dest` is NULL, the bytes are skipped without copying.
requirements: buffer must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
count + buffer->position must be less than or equal to buffer->length.
If data_dest is non-NULL, it must point to a region of at least `count` bytes.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK; errors include NULL/invalid buffer, non-allocated content, or insufficient unread data.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Copy
functions.description: Copies all data bytes and buffer properties from `src` to `dest`. Destination must have enough capacity to hold `src`'s data length.
requirements: dest and src must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
dest->maximum_size must be greater than or equal to src->length.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK; errors include NULL pointers, non-allocated content, or incompatible size.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_CopyWithLength
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_CopyWithLength(SOPC_Buffer* dest, SOPC_Buffer* src, uint32_t limitedLength);
functions.description: Copies buffer properties and the first `limitedLength` bytes from `src` into `dest`, and sets `dest` length to `limitedLength`.
requirements: dest and src must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
dest->maximum_size must be greater than or equal to limitedLength.
src->length must be greater than or equal to limitedLength.
src->position must be less than or equal to limitedLength.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK; errors include NULL pointers, non-allocated content, or incompatible sizes/lengths.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_Remaining
functions.description: Returns the number of unread bytes remaining in the buffer (typically length - position).
requirements: buffer must be a valid pointer; content should be allocated for meaningful results.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_ReadFrom
functions.signature: int64_t SOPC_Buffer_ReadFrom(SOPC_Buffer* buffer, SOPC_Buffer* src, uint32_t n);
functions.description: Reads up to `n` bytes from `src` into `buffer`. Returns the number of bytes actually read on success, or -1 on failure.
requirements: buffer and src must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
n specifies the maximum number of bytes to read; the function may read fewer if fewer are available or capacity limits apply.
Caller must check for a negative return value (-1) to detect failure.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_ReadFile
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_ReadFile(const char* path, SOPC_Buffer** buf);
functions.description: Reads the contents of the file at `path` into a newly allocated SOPC_Buffer returned via `buf`. On success returns SOPC_STATUS_OK; on failure returns an error code. The resulting buffer must be freed by the caller.
requirements: path should point to a valid file path (non-NULL; NULL behavior not specified).
buf must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the allocated buffer pointer.
On success, the caller is responsible for freeing the returned buffer (e.g., via SOPC_Buffer_Delete).
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK before using `*buf`.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_PrintU32
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_PrintU32(SOPC_Buffer* buf, const uint32_t value);
functions.description: Formats the unsigned 32-bit integer `value` as text and appends it to `buf` at the current position, updating position and length as needed. No terminating NUL character is added.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
Buffer must have enough remaining capacity to hold the textual representation; otherwise the call fails.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_PrintI32
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_PrintI32(SOPC_Buffer* buf, const int32_t value);
functions.description: Formats the signed 32-bit integer `value` as text and appends it to `buf` at the current position, updating position and length as needed. No terminating NUL is added. For positive values, spacing for '-' is not reserved.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
Buffer must have enough remaining capacity to hold the textual representation; otherwise the call fails.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_PrintFloatDouble
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_PrintFloatDouble(SOPC_Buffer* buf, const double value);
functions.description: Formats the double `value` as text and appends it to `buf` at the current position, updating position and length as needed. Output is equivalent to printf format '%.*g' with SOPC_PRECISION_PRINTING_FLOAT_NUMBERS precision. Special values are printed JSON-compatibly: "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity". No terminating NUL is added.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
Buffer must have enough remaining capacity to hold the textual representation; otherwise the call fails.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK.

functions.name: SOPC_Buffer_PrintCString
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Buffer_PrintCString(SOPC_Buffer* buf, const char* value);
functions.description: Prints the C string `value` into `buf` at the current position, updating position and length. If `value` is NULL, the literal "<null>" is printed. No terminating NUL is added.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and have allocated content.
If value is non-NULL, it must point to a valid C string (NUL-terminated) to be read until its terminator.
Buffer must have enough remaining capacity to hold the string; otherwise the call fails.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for SOPC_STATUS_OK.

functions.name: SOPC_strncmp_ignore_case
functions.signature: int SOPC_strncmp_ignore_case(const char* s1, const char* s2, size_t size);
functions.description: Case-insensitive comparison of two C strings, considering at most `size` characters (or earlier if a '\0' is encountered). Returns 0 if equal (case-insensitive), -1 if s1 < s2, +1 if s1 > s2 based on lowercase character comparison, and -1000 on invalid parameters. Use to compare prefixes or bounded segments ignoring case.
requirements: s1 must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
s2 must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
size specifies the maximum number of characters to compare; comparison may stop earlier at a '\0'.
Caller must handle return value -1000 as an invalid-parameter error condition.

functions.name: SOPC_strcmp_ignore_case
functions.signature: int SOPC_strcmp_ignore_case(const char* s1, const char* s2);
functions.description: Case-insensitive comparison of two entire C strings. Returns 0 if equal (case-insensitive), -1 if s1 < s2, +1 if s1 > s2 based on lowercase character comparison, and -1000 on invalid parameters. Use when full-string case-insensitive equality or ordering is needed.
requirements: s1 must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
s2 must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
Caller must handle return value -1000 as an invalid-parameter error condition.

functions.name: SOPC_strcmp_ignore_case_alt_end
functions.signature: int SOPC_strcmp_ignore_case_alt_end(const char* s1, const char* s2, char endCharacter);
functions.description: Case-insensitive comparison of two C strings, stopping at either the given endCharacter or a '\0'. Returns 0 if equal up to the end condition, -1 if s1 < s2, +1 if s1 > s2 based on lowercase character comparison, and -1000 on invalid parameters. Useful for comparing tokens delimited by a specific character.
requirements: s1 must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string (may contain endCharacter).
s2 must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string (may contain endCharacter).
endCharacter specifies an additional terminating character for comparison.
Caller must handle return value -1000 as an invalid-parameter error condition.

functions.name: SOPC_strtouint8_t
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_strtouint8_t(const char* sz, uint8_t* n, int base, char cEnd);
functions.description: Parses an unsigned 8-bit integer from a C string using strtoul-like semantics. On success writes the value to *n and returns SOPC_STATUS_OK. Parsing stops where strtoul would stop; the first unconsumed character must match cEnd (which may be '\0').
requirements: sz must be a non-NULL pointer to a C string containing the number.
n must be a non-NULL pointer to a uint8_t storage location.
base must be compatible with strtoul (typically 0 or 2..36).
The parsed numeric value must fit in uint8_t (0..255).
The first character of the unconsumed part of sz after parsing must equal cEnd (may be '\0').
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success before using *n.

functions.name: SOPC_strtouint16_t
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_strtouint16_t(const char* sz, uint16_t* n, int base, char cEnd);
functions.description: Parses an unsigned 16-bit integer from a C string using strtoul-like semantics. On success writes the value to *n and returns SOPC_STATUS_OK. The first unconsumed character must match cEnd (may be '\0').
requirements: sz must be a non-NULL pointer to a C string containing the number.
n must be a non-NULL pointer to a uint16_t storage location.
base must be compatible with strtoul (typically 0 or 2..36).
The parsed numeric value must fit in uint16_t (0..65535).
The first character of the unconsumed part of sz after parsing must equal cEnd (may be '\0').
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success before using *n.

functions.name: SOPC_strtouint32_t
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_strtouint32_t(const char* sz, uint32_t* n, int base, char cEnd);
functions.description: Parses an unsigned 32-bit integer from a C string using strtoul-like semantics. On success writes the value to *n and returns SOPC_STATUS_OK. The first unconsumed character must match cEnd (may be '\0').
requirements: sz must be a non-NULL pointer to a C string containing the number.
n must be a non-NULL pointer to a uint32_t storage location.
base must be compatible with strtoul (typically 0 or 2..36).
The parsed numeric value must fit in uint32_t.
The first character of the unconsumed part of sz after parsing must equal cEnd (may be '\0').
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success before using *n.

functions.name: SOPC_strtoint
functions.signature: bool SOPC_strtoint(const char* data, size_t len, uint8_t width, void* dest);
functions.description: Parses a signed integer in base 10 from a bounded substring using strtoll. On success stores the value to dest (which must point to an int<width>_t) and returns true. Intended for fixed-width signed integers extracted from a string segment.
requirements: data must be a non-NULL pointer to a C string segment containing a base-10 number.
len must be <= 20 (the length considered for parsing).
width must be the number of bits of the destination signed integer type.
dest must be a non-NULL pointer to an integer object of type int<width>_t.
The substring defined by [data, data+len) must represent a value that fits in the chosen int<width>_t.
Caller must check the boolean return and use dest only when the function returns true.

functions.name: SOPC_strtouint
functions.signature: bool SOPC_strtouint(const char* data, size_t len, uint8_t width, void* dest);
functions.description: Parses an unsigned integer in base 10 from a bounded substring using strtoull. On success stores the value to dest (which must point to a uint<width>_t) and returns true. Intended for fixed-width unsigned integers extracted from a string segment.
requirements: data must be a non-NULL pointer to a C string segment containing a base-10 number.
len must be <= 20 (the length considered for parsing).
width must be the number of bits of the destination unsigned integer type.
dest must be a non-NULL pointer to an integer object of type uint<width>_t.
The substring defined by [data, data+len) must represent a value that fits in the chosen uint<width>_t.
Caller must check the boolean return and use dest only when the function returns true.

functions.name: SOPC_strtodouble
functions.signature: bool SOPC_strtodouble(const char* data, size_t len, uint8_t width, void* dest);
functions.description: Parses a floating-point value from a bounded substring using strtod. On success writes the value to dest and returns true. If width==32, dest must be a float*; if width==64, dest must be a double*. Intended to parse decimal floating literals from a string segment.
requirements: data must be a non-NULL pointer to a C string segment containing a floating-point literal.
len must be <= 339 (the length considered for parsing).
width must be the number of bits of the destination floating type; accepted values are 32 (float) or 64 (double).
dest must be a non-NULL pointer: float* if width==32, double* if width==64.
The substring defined by [data, data+len) must represent a value that can be converted to the chosen type without violating its representable range.
Caller must check the boolean return and use dest only when the function returns true.

functions.name: SOPC_strdup
functions.description: Duplicates the given C string and returns a newly allocated copy, or NULL on failure. Use when you need an owned copy of an input string.
requirements: s should be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
The returned pointer must be freed by the caller using the library-appropriate deallocation routine (not specified here; typically SOPC_Free).
Caller must check for a NULL return to detect allocation failure.

functions.name: SOPC_StrConcat
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_StrConcat(const char* left, const char* right, char** str);
functions.description: Allocates and returns in str the concatenation of two C strings: left + right. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success. The caller must free the resulting string with SOPC_Free.
requirements: left must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
right must be a non-NULL pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
str must be a non-NULL pointer to a char* variable to receive the newly allocated string.
The returned string must be freed by the caller using SOPC_Free.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success before using *str.

functions.name: OpcUa_KeyValuePair_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_KeyValuePair structure (encodeable type) to a valid default state, preparing its fields for use and subsequent encoding/decoding.
requirements: pValue must be a non-NULL pointer to an allocated OpcUa_KeyValuePair instance
Caller must pass a pointer to the correct structure type (void* is used in the API)
After initialization, fields are set to defaults; actual default values are not documented here

functions.name: OpcUa_KeyValuePair_Clear
functions.description: Clears and releases resources held by an OpcUa_KeyValuePair structure, resetting it to an empty state suitable for reuse or deallocation.
requirements: pValue must be a non-NULL pointer to an OpcUa_KeyValuePair instance
The instance should have been initialized before clearing (by Initialize or via valid construction)
After Clear, referenced dynamic resources owned by the struct may be freed; do not reuse inner pointers

functions.name: OpcUa_AdditionalParametersType_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_AdditionalParametersType structure to default values.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_AdditionalParametersType instance
Pointer must be to the correct structure type

functions.name: OpcUa_AdditionalParametersType_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_AdditionalParametersType structure and frees/zeros its dynamically held members.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_AdditionalParametersType instance
The structure should have been initialized prior to clearing
Do not use inner pointers after clearing

functions.name: OpcUa_EphemeralKeyType_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_EphemeralKeyType structure (public key, signature) to default state.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_EphemeralKeyType instance

functions.name: OpcUa_EphemeralKeyType_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_EphemeralKeyType structure and releases owned buffers.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_EphemeralKeyType instance
Should be called on an initialized structure

functions.name: OpcUa_EndpointType_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_EndpointType structure (endpoint URL, security mode/policy, transport) to defaults.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_EndpointType instance

functions.name: OpcUa_EndpointType_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_EndpointType structure and releases any dynamically allocated members.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_EndpointType instance
Only call on an initialized/valid structure

functions.name: OpcUa_RationalNumber_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_RationalNumber structure (Numerator, Denominator) to defaults.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_RationalNumber instance

functions.name: OpcUa_RationalNumber_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_RationalNumber structure.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_RationalNumber instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDVector_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_ThreeDVector structure (X,Y,Z doubles).
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDVector instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDVector_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_ThreeDVector structure.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDVector instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDCartesianCoordinates_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_ThreeDCartesianCoordinates structure (X,Y,Z doubles).
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDCartesianCoordinates instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDCartesianCoordinates_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_ThreeDCartesianCoordinates structure.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDCartesianCoordinates instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDOrientation_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_ThreeDOrientation structure (A,B,C angles).
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDOrientation instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDOrientation_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_ThreeDOrientation structure.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDOrientation instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDFrame_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_ThreeDFrame structure (CartesianCoordinates + Orientation) to defaults.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDFrame instance

functions.name: OpcUa_ThreeDFrame_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_ThreeDFrame structure and its nested members.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_ThreeDFrame instance
Call only on an initialized/valid structure

functions.name: OpcUa_IdentityMappingRuleType_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_IdentityMappingRuleType structure (criteria type and value).
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_IdentityMappingRuleType instance

functions.name: OpcUa_IdentityMappingRuleType_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_IdentityMappingRuleType structure and its dynamic members.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL and point to an OpcUa_IdentityMappingRuleType instance

functions.name: OpcUa_CurrencyUnitType_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_CurrencyUnitType instance pointed to by pValue. Sets fields (NumericCode, Exponent, AlphabeticCode, Currency) to default/empty values so the struct is ready for use (e.g., encoding/decoding).
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL
pValue must point to a valid OpcUa_CurrencyUnitType object (not a different type)
Call before first use and before Clear
Thread-safety: unknown

functions.name: OpcUa_CurrencyUnitType_Clear
functions.description: Clears and resets an OpcUa_CurrencyUnitType instance pointed to by pValue. Releases/clears dynamically owned members and resets scalars to defaults to prevent leaks.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL
pValue must point to an OpcUa_CurrencyUnitType that was previously initialized
Do not use internal pointers after calling Clear; re-initialize before reuse
Thread-safety: unknown

functions.name: OpcUa_TrustListDataType_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_TrustListDataType instance so it has default/empty state (counts set to 0 and pointers to NULL).
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL
pValue must point to a valid OpcUa_TrustListDataType
Call before first use and before Clear

functions.name: OpcUa_TrustListDataType_Clear
functions.description: Clears an OpcUa_TrustListDataType instance, releasing any dynamically allocated arrays (TrustedCertificates, TrustedCrls, IssuerCertificates, IssuerCrls) and resetting counters.
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL
pValue must point to a previously-initialized OpcUa_TrustListDataType
After Clear, do not access freed arrays; reinitialize before reuse

functions.name: OpcUa_DecimalDataType_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes an OpcUa_DecimalDataType instance (sets Scale and Value to defaults/empty).
requirements: pValue must be non-NULL
pValue must point to OpcUa_DecimalDataType

functions.name: SOPC_Initialize_EnumeratedType
functions.description: Initializes a 32-bit enumerated value to a default (implementation-defined) state for subsequent encoding/decoding in S2OPC.
requirements: enumerationValue must be non-NULL
The pointed value is set to a default; specific default not documented here

functions.name: SOPC_Clear_EnumeratedType
functions.description: Clears an enumerated value; provided for API symmetry with other encodeable types.
requirements: enumerationValue must be non-NULL
Intended to reset the value; no dynamic memory is involved

functions.name: SOPC_Read_EnumeratedType
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Read_EnumeratedType(SOPC_Buffer* buf, int32_t* enumerationValue, uint32_t nestedStructLevel);
functions.description: Decodes a 32-bit enumerated value from a binary buffer according to S2OPC encoding rules.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and positioned at the start of the encoded enum
enumerationValue must be non-NULL and writable
nestedStructLevel must follow the caller’s current nested structure depth tracking (used to prevent excessive nesting)
Return status indicates success/failure; caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus

functions.name: SOPC_Write_EnumeratedType
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_Write_EnumeratedType(SOPC_Buffer* buf, const int32_t* enumerationValue, uint32_t nestedStructLevel);
functions.description: Encodes a 32-bit enumerated value into a binary buffer according to S2OPC encoding rules.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and have sufficient remaining capacity for the encoded value
enumerationValue must be non-NULL and point to the value to encode
nestedStructLevel must follow the caller’s current nested structure depth tracking
Return status indicates success/failure; caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus

functions.name: SOPC_S2OPC_Config_Initialize
functions.description: Initialize an S2OPC (client/server) configuration structure in-place. Intended to set default/empty values for both the embedded server and client configs by invoking SOPC_ServerConfig_Initialize and SOPC_ClientConfig_Initialize. Call before populating or using the config.
requirements: config must be a valid, writable pointer to an allocated SOPC_S2OPC_Config instance.
Should be called before any use of config fields or a subsequent SOPC_S2OPC_Config_Clear.
Thread-safety and reentrancy are unknown; avoid concurrent access to the same config during initialization.

functions.name: SOPC_S2OPC_Config_Clear
functions.description: Clear an S2OPC (client/server) configuration structure in-place. Frees/cleans any content previously set by initialization or later configuration by invoking SOPC_ServerConfig_Clear and SOPC_ClientConfig_Clear.
requirements: config must be a valid, writable pointer to an allocated SOPC_S2OPC_Config instance.
The structure should have been previously initialized with SOPC_S2OPC_Config_Initialize (or otherwise properly set) before clearing.
Do not access fields that may be freed/invalidated after this call; reinitialize before reuse.
Thread-safety is unknown; avoid concurrent access to the same config while clearing.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfig_Initialize
functions.description: Initialize a server configuration structure in-place, setting it to a known default/empty state before use.
requirements: config must be a valid, writable pointer to an allocated SOPC_Server_Config instance.
Call before populating server configuration fields or calling SOPC_ServerConfig_Clear.
Avoid concurrent access to the same config during initialization (thread-safety unknown).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfig_Clear
functions.description: Clear a server configuration structure in-place, releasing or resetting any resources/fields set during configuration or initialization.
requirements: config must be a valid, writable pointer to an allocated SOPC_Server_Config instance.
The structure should have been previously initialized with SOPC_ServerConfig_Initialize (or otherwise properly set) before clearing.
Do not use freed/invalidated fields after this call; reinitialize before reuse.
Avoid concurrent access to the same config during clearing (thread-safety unknown).

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfig_Initialize
functions.description: Initialize a client configuration structure in-place, setting it to a known default/empty state before use.
requirements: config must be a valid, writable pointer to an allocated SOPC_Client_Config instance.
Call before populating client configuration fields or calling SOPC_ClientConfig_Clear.
Avoid concurrent access to the same config during initialization (thread-safety unknown).

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfig_Clear
functions.description: Clear a client configuration structure in-place, releasing or resetting any resources/fields set during configuration or initialization.
requirements: config must be a valid, writable pointer to an allocated SOPC_Client_Config instance.
The structure should have been previously initialized with SOPC_ClientConfig_Initialize (or otherwise properly set) before clearing.
Do not use freed/invalidated fields after this call; reinitialize before reuse.
Avoid concurrent access to the same config during clearing (thread-safety unknown).

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitServer_AsyncOpenEndpoint
functions.description: Asynchronously requests opening the server listener for the provided endpoint configuration. On failure, SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT is sent to the application callback; on success, consider the listener opened.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling any service (module requirement).
endpointConfigIdx must be a valid server endpoint configuration index previously obtained from SOPC_ToolkitServer_AddEndpointConfig().
Application must have provided a SOPC_ComEvent_Fct() callback via toolkit configuration to receive SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT.

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitServer_AsyncCloseEndpoint
functions.description: Asynchronously requests closing the server listener for the given endpoint configuration. SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT is always sent to the application callback; once received, the listener can be considered closed if it was open.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConfigIdx must be the same identifier used with SOPC_ToolkitServer_AsyncOpenEndpoint() for this endpoint.
Application must have provided SOPC_ComEvent_Fct() to receive SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT.

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitServer_AsyncLocalServiceRequest
functions.signature: void SOPC_ToolkitServer_AsyncLocalServiceRequest(SOPC_EndpointConfigIdx endpointConfigIdx, void* requestStruct, uintptr_t requestContext);
functions.description: Executes an OPC UA service request locally on the server and delivers the response asynchronously via SE_LOCAL_SERVICE_RESPONSE to the application callback. The request payload structure (OpcUa_<MessageStruct>*) is freed by the toolkit.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConfigIdx must correspond to a valid configured server endpoint.
requestStruct must point to a valid OPC UA request payload structure type (OpcUa_<MessageStruct>*).
Caller must not free or reuse requestStruct after the call; ownership is transferred to the toolkit and it will be deallocated.
Application must handle SE_LOCAL_SERVICE_RESPONSE via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitServer_TriggerEvent
functions.signature: void SOPC_ToolkitServer_TriggerEvent(const SOPC_NodeId* notifierNodeId, SOPC_Event* event, SOPC_SessionId optSessionId, uint32_t optSubscriptionId, uint32_t optMonitoredItemId);
functions.description: Triggers a server-side event from the specified notifier node. Optional scoping to a session, subscription, and monitored item. If both session and subscription are provided, the event is triggered only if the subscription belongs to the session. The event object and its contents are freed by the toolkit.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
notifierNodeId must be a valid pointer to a NodeId identifying the notifier node.
event must be a valid pointer; caller transfers ownership and must not use or free it after the call (it is deallocated by the toolkit).
optSessionId may be 0 to indicate no session scoping.
optSubscriptionId may be 0 to indicate no subscription scoping; if both optSessionId and optSubscriptionId are set, the event is only triggered if the subscription belongs to the given session.
optMonitoredItemId may be 0 to indicate no monitored item scoping.

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitServer_AsyncReEvalSecureChannels
functions.description: Requests re-evaluation of all server secure channels due to certificate/key or PKI trust list updates. If ownCert is true (server cert/key update), secure channels using the certificate are closed. If false (PKI trust list update), channels with now untrusted/invalid client certificates are closed.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
ownCert must be true for server certificate/key update, false for server PKI trust list update.

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitServer_AsyncReEvalUserCertSessions
functions.description: Requests re-evaluation of X509IdentityToken user certificates for all active sessions due to user PKI trust list update. Sessions with invalid or untrusted user certificates are closed.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.

functions.name: SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg_CreateClassic
functions.description: Builds an endpoint-connection configuration for a classic (client-initiated) connection using the given secure channel configuration index.
requirements: secureChannelConfigIdx must be a valid secure channel configuration index previously returned by SOPC_ToolkitClient_AddSecureChannelConfig().
secureChannelConfigIdx must not be 0 (per struct documentation).

functions.name: SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg_CreateReverse
functions.description: Builds an endpoint-connection configuration for a reverse (server-initiated) connection using the given reverse endpoint configuration and secure channel configuration indices.
requirements: reverseEndpointConfigIdx must be a valid reverse endpoint configuration index returned by SOPC_ToolkitClient_AddReverseEndpointConfig().
secureChannelConfigIdx must be a valid secure channel configuration index returned by SOPC_ToolkitClient_AddSecureChannelConfig().
secureChannelConfigIdx must not be 0 (per struct documentation).

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession(SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg endpointConnectionCfg, const char* sessionName, uintptr_t sessionContext, SOPC_ExtensionObject* userToken, void* userTokenCtx);
functions.description: Asynchronously activates a new client session on the provided endpoint connection configuration. The toolkit will establish a secure channel (if needed), create the session, and activate it. On failure, SE_SESSION_ACTIVATION_FAILURE is signaled; on success, SE_ACTIVATED_SESSION is signaled with a session Id for further operations. The userToken is borrowed by the toolkit and must not be modified or freed by the caller.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConnectionCfg must reference valid connection parameters (classic or reverse) using non-zero secure channel config index.
sessionName may be NULL; if provided, it should be unique for the client (advisory).

userToken must be an extension object containing either OpcUa_AnonymousIdentityToken, OpcUa_UserNameIdentityToken, or OpcUa_X509IdentityToken; ownership is not transferred and it must not be freed or modified by the caller while in use by the toolkit.
userTokenCtx must be an allocated SOPC_SerializedAsymmetricKey* when userToken is an OpcUa_X509IdentityToken, otherwise must be NULL; it will be deallocated by the toolkit.
Return value: SOPC_STATUS_OK on successful queuing, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS or SOPC_STATUS_OUT_OF_MEMORY otherwise.
Application must handle SE_SESSION_ACTIVATION_FAILURE and SE_ACTIVATED_SESSION via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession_Anonymous
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession_Anonymous(SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg endpointConnectionCfg, const char* sessionName, uintptr_t sessionContext, const char* policyId);
functions.description: Convenience function to asynchronously activate an anonymous session. Internally calls SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession().
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConnectionCfg must be valid (non-zero secure channel config index).
sessionName may be NULL; if provided, it should be unique for the client.
policyId must identify the identity token policy to use (may be implementation-defined).
Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK when the underlying activation request was successfully issued; otherwise an error status.

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession_UsernamePassword
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession_UsernamePassword(SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg endpointConnectionCfg, const char* sessionName, uintptr_t sessionContext, const char* policyId, const char* username, const uint8_t* password, int32_t length_password);
functions.description: Convenience function to asynchronously activate a session using a UserNameIdentityToken. Password handling depends on the user token security policy and/or the SecureChannel security policy. WARNING: Do not use when SC security policy is None and user token policy is None/empty, or when SC mode is Sign-only and user token policy is None, because the password would be sent in clear text.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConnectionCfg must be valid (non-zero secure channel config index).
sessionName may be NULL; if provided, it should be unique for the client.
policyId must not be NULL.
username may be NULL.
password may be NULL; when NULL, length_password is ignored.
Caller should ensure security policies avoid clear-text password as warned in the documentation.
Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK when the underlying activation request was successfully issued; otherwise an error status.

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession_Certificate
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncActivateSession_Certificate(SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg endpointConnectionCfg, const char* sessionName, uintptr_t sessionContext, const char* policyId, const SOPC_SerializedCertificate* pCertX509, SOPC_SerializedAsymmetricKey* pKey);
functions.description: Convenience function to asynchronously activate a session using an X509IdentityToken (certificate/private key). The private key object must not be freed by the caller; the toolkit takes ownership and will free it.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConnectionCfg must be valid (non-zero secure channel config index).
sessionName may be NULL; if provided, it should be unique for the client.
policyId must not be NULL.
pCertX509 must point to the X.509 user certificate.
pKey must be a valid pointer to the corresponding private key; ownership is transferred to the toolkit, and the caller must not free it.
Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK when the underlying activation request was successfully issued; otherwise an error status.

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncSendRequestOnSession
functions.signature: void SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncSendRequestOnSession(SOPC_SessionId sessionId, void* requestStruct, uintptr_t requestContext);
functions.description: Sends an OPC UA service request on an active client session. Responses trigger SE_RCV_SESSION_RESPONSE to the application callback. The request payload structure is freed by the toolkit.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
sessionId must be a valid active session identifier provided via SE_ACTIVATED_SESSION.
requestStruct must point to a valid OPC UA request payload structure (OpcUa_<MessageStruct>*).
Caller must not free or reuse requestStruct after the call; the toolkit deallocates it.
Application must handle SE_RCV_SESSION_RESPONSE via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncCloseSession
functions.description: Asynchronously requests closing the specified client session. When closed, SE_CLOSED_SESSION is sent to the application callback.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
sessionId must be a valid session identifier previously provided by SE_ACTIVATED_SESSION.
Application must handle SE_CLOSED_SESSION via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncSendDiscoveryRequest
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncSendDiscoveryRequest(SOPC_EndpointConnectionCfg endpointConnectionCfg, void* discoveryReqStruct, uintptr_t requestContext);
functions.description: Sends a discovery service request without creating a session. Responses trigger SE_RCV_DISCOVERY_RESPONSE to the application callback. The discovery request payload structure is freed by the toolkit.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConnectionCfg must be valid for contacting the discovery endpoint.
discoveryReqStruct must point to a valid OPC UA discovery request payload structure (OpcUa_<MessageStruct>*).
Caller must not free or reuse discoveryReqStruct after the call; the toolkit deallocates it.
Return value: SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS or SOPC_STATUS_OUT_OF_MEMORY otherwise.
Application must handle SE_RCV_DISCOVERY_RESPONSE via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncCloseChannel
functions.description: Asynchronously requests closing the secure channel associated with the provided endpoint connection configuration. When closed, SE_CLOSED_CHANNEL is sent with the provided context.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
endpointConnectionCfg must identify the channel to be closed (same configuration used to open it).
Application must handle SE_CLOSED_CHANNEL via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncOpenReverseEndpoint
functions.description: Asynchronously requests opening a reverse-connection listener for the given reverse endpoint configuration on the client side. On failure, SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT is sent; otherwise consider the listener opened.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
reverseEndpointConfigIdx must be a valid reverse endpoint configuration index obtained from SOPC_ToolkitClient_AddReverseEndpointConfig().
Application must handle SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncCloseReverseEndpoint
functions.description: Asynchronously requests closing the client reverse-connection listener. SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT is always sent; once received, the listener must be considered closed if it was open.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
reverseEndpointConfigIdx must be the same identifier used with SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncOpenReverseEndpoint().
Application must handle SE_CLOSED_ENDPOINT via SOPC_ComEvent_Fct().

functions.name: SOPC_ToolkitClient_AsyncReEvalSecureChannels
functions.description: Requests re-evaluation of all client secure channels due to client certificate/key or PKI trust list updates. If ownCert is true (client cert/key update), secure channels using the certificate are closed. If false (PKI trust list update), channels with now untrusted/invalid server certificates are closed.
requirements: Toolkit must be configured before calling.
ownCert must be true for client certificate/key update, false for client PKI trust list update.

functions.name: SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize(const SOPC_Log_Configuration* optLogConfig, const SOPC_Audit_Configuration* optAuditConfig);
functions.description: Initializes the S2OPC Client/Server frontend library: starts internal threads and sets up common configuration with an optional custom log and (optionally) audit configuration. Must be called before any other S2OPC Client/Server helper operations. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE on double initialization.
requirements: Must be called before any other S2OPC Client/Server helper operation.
Not thread-safe; must be called from the same thread as SOPC_CommonHelper_Clear.
optLogConfig may be NULL to keep the default logging configuration.
optAuditConfig may be NULL for non-auditing applications; if S2OPC_HAS_AUDITING is not defined, optAuditConfig shall be NULL.
The content pointed to by optAuditConfig may be freed/modified after the call (i.e., the function copies what it needs).
Caller must handle the return value: SOPC_STATUS_OK on success; SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE indicates double initialization.
Calling this function more than once without a corresponding clear results in SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_CommonHelper_Clear
functions.description: Clears and shuts down the S2OPC Client/Server frontend library: stops internal threads and releases common configuration. Should be called after all Client/Server wrapper Clear operations and paired with a prior SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize.
requirements: Not thread-safe; must be called from the same thread as SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize.
Should be called only after all dependent Client/Server wrapper Clear operations have completed.
Must only be called if the helper has been initialized (implied pairing with SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize).

functions.name: SOPC_CommonHelper_GetBuildInfo
functions.description: Returns the S2OPC Client/Server toolkit build information (e.g., version, date). Convenience wrapper for SOPC_ToolkitConfig_GetBuildInfo.
requirements: No parameters.
Return value should be consumed as read-only build metadata.

functions.name: SOPC_CommonHelper_GetConfiguration
functions.description: Retrieves a pointer to the S2OPC Client/Server configuration. Intended to be called after initialization and before clearing the helper. The returned pointer is guaranteed non-NULL. Applications generally must not modify fields except where explicitly allowed for server applications (PKI, user PKI, and server key/certificate updates via thread-safe APIs).
requirements: Must be called after SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize and before SOPC_CommonHelper_Clear.
Returned pointer is guaranteed non-NULL per documentation; treat the configuration as read-only unless explicitly allowed.

For server applications only, allowed modifications/access at runtime are limited to: serverConfig.pki (may be modified during configuration to implement TOFU), serverConfig.pki and serverConfig.authenticationManager->pUsrPKI (may be accessed to update PKIs via thread-safe APIs), and serverConfig.serverKeyCertPair (may be accessed to update server key/certificate via thread-safe APIs).
Modifying other fields is reserved for internal libs2opc use and may cause undefined behavior.

functions.name: SOPC_CommonHelper_GetInitialized
functions.description: Returns whether the S2OPC Client/Server frontend helper has been initialized via SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize.
requirements: No parameters.
Use as a state check before invoking operations that require initialization.

functions.name: SOPC_SecurityPolicyUriToCstring
functions.description: Converts a SOPC_SecurityPolicy_URI enum value to its corresponding security policy URI C string. Returns NULL if the value is invalid.
requirements: Input secuUri must be a valid SOPC_SecurityPolicy_URI value; otherwise the function returns NULL.
Caller must handle a possible NULL return to avoid dereferencing a null pointer.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes the S2OPC client frontend configuration. Call this once before any other client operation and after SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize. Sets a default log configuration (via SOPC_Common_GetDefaultLogConfiguration). Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE on double initialization.
requirements: Must be called after SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize.
Must be called before any other client configuration or operation.
Do not call twice without clearing; a second call without prior clear may return SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success or failure.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_Clear
functions.description: Clears the S2OPC client frontend configuration. Disconnects remaining client connections, deletes subscriptions, and closes reverse endpoints. Should be called before SOPC_CommonHelper_Clear. After this call, the configuration, connections, and subscriptions must no longer be accessed.
requirements: Must be called before SOPC_CommonHelper_Clear.
Caller must ensure no further access to configuration, connections, or subscriptions after calling this function.
May disconnect active connections and delete subscriptions (callers should be prepared for this side effect).

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_ConfigureFromXML
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_ConfigureFromXML(const char* clientConfigPath, SOPC_ConfigClientXML_Custom* customConfig, size_t* nbScConfigs, SOPC_SecureConnection_Config*** scConfigArray);
functions.description: Parses and loads client secure connection configuration(s) from an XML file (schema: s2opc_clientserver_config.xsd). On success returns the number of secure connection configurations and a pointer to an array of SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* of that length. Use this to bulk-load client connection settings.
requirements: customConfig shall be NULL (reserved for future use).
clientConfigPath must reference a valid XML file conforming to s2opc_clientserver_config.xsd; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_NOK (parsing) or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS may be returned.
nbScConfigs must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.
scConfigArray must be a valid non-NULL output pointer that will receive the array pointer.
Toolkit must be properly initialized; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE may be returned (e.g., toolkit not initialized, incompatible state such as server/client already started).
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success or failure before using outputs.
If configuration is not loaded prior to calling getters, lookups by id will not find entries.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_GetConfigFromId
functions.description: Returns the first secure connection configuration whose user-defined identifier (the XML connection id attribute) matches userDefinedId. Returns NULL if none is found. Use after configurations have been loaded (e.g., via XML).
requirements: userDefinedId is compared to the id attribute of configured secure connections; if several match, the first is returned.
Returns NULL if no matching configuration exists; caller must check for NULL before use.
Requires that secure connections have been configured beforehand (e.g., via SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_ConfigureFromXML).

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_GetUserIdFromConfig
functions.description: Returns the user-defined identifier (XML id attribute) associated with the given secure connection configuration. Returns NULL if no id is defined for that configuration.
requirements: secConnConfig must refer to a valid secure connection configuration (e.g., obtained from configuration loading or earlier APIs).
Caller must handle a NULL return value when the configuration has no defined id.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetServiceAsyncResponse
functions.description: Sets the callback invoked for asynchronous service responses (used with SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsync). Optional when using only synchronous services. Must be set before starting the client and before issuing asynchronous requests. The callback must avoid blocking or long processing, otherwise it will block other callbacks and notifications.
requirements: asyncRespCb must be a valid function pointer; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS may be returned.

Must be called before starting the client and before using SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsync; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE may be returned (e.g., toolkit not initialized, client connection initiated).
The provided callback shall not perform blocking or long-running operations to avoid blocking other callbacks.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success or failure.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetUserNamePasswordCallback
functions.description: Registers the callback used to retrieve the username and password for session activation when a username token is used. Must be set before starting the client and before loading/configuring the secure channel.
requirements: getClientUsernamePassword must be a valid function pointer; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS may be returned.
Must be called before starting the client and before loading configuration / configuring the secure channel; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE may be returned.

The provided callback must allocate zero-terminated strings on success and, on failure, free any allocated memory for outUserName/outPassword and set them back to NULL (as specified by the callback type contract).
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success or failure.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetUserKeyPasswordCallback
functions.description: Registers the callback used to retrieve the password to decrypt the user X509 token private key. Optional; if used, set it before starting the client and before loading/configuring the secure channel.
requirements: getClientX509userKeyPassword must be a valid function pointer; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS may be returned.
Must be called before starting the client and before configuration of the secure channel; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE may be returned.
The provided callback must, on failure, free any allocated memory for the output password and set it back to NULL (as specified by the callback type contract).
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success or failure.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetClientKeyPasswordCallback
functions.description: Registers the callback used to retrieve the password to decrypt the client application's private key. Optional; if used, set it before starting the client and before loading/configuring the secure channel.
requirements: getClientKeyPassword must be a valid function pointer; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS is returned.
Must be called before configuration of the secure channel and before starting the client.
The provided callback must, on failure, free any allocated memory for the output password and set it back to NULL (as specified by the callback type contract).
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus for success or failure.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetPreferredLocaleIds
functions.description: Sets the client’s preferred locale identifiers, ordered by preference, from an array of locale strings. The array and its content are copied. Use when configuring a client without XML to influence localized texts returned by the server.
requirements: The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Must be called before preferred locales are already defined and before any client connection is initiated; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
If nbLocales > 0, localeIds must be non-NULL and point to nbLocales valid, null-terminated strings; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
Passing nbLocales == 0 is allowed (no preferred locales).
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetApplicationDescription
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetApplicationDescription(const char* applicationUri, const char* productUri, const char* defaultAppName, const char* defaultAppNameLocale, OpcUa_ApplicationType applicationType)
functions.description: Defines the client application description (URIs, default localized name, type). Use to set basic application identity and type when not using XML config.
