requirements: The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Must be called before the application description is already set and before any client connection is initiated; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
applicationUri, productUri, and defaultAppName must be valid non-NULL strings; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
If defaultAppNameLocale is provided, it shall exist in supported locales (if locales were configured).
applicationType must be one of the OpcUa_ApplicationType_Client* values as appropriate for a client.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetPKIprovider
functions.description: Sets the PKI provider used by the client to validate peer certificates. The provider is owned and freed by the library on clear.
requirements: The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Must be called before PKI provider is already defined and before the server/client is started/connection initiated; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
pki must be a valid pointer; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
Do not free the PKI provider after passing it; it will be deallocated by the library on SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_Clear.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromPath
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromPath(const char* clientCertPath, const char* clientKeyPath, bool encrypted)
functions.description: Sets the client’s asymmetric certificate and private key from file paths. Certificate must be DER; key may be DER or PEM. The paths are copied.
requirements: The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Must be called before a key/cert pair is already set and before any connection is initiated; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
clientCertPath and clientKeyPath must be valid non-NULL paths; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
Certificate file must be in DER format; key file must be DER or PEM format.
encrypted indicates whether the key file is encrypted; ensure any required key decryption handling is available in the environment.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromBytes
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromBytes(size_t certificateNbBytes, const unsigned char* clientCertificate, size_t keyNbBytes, const unsigned char* clientPrivateKey)
functions.description: Sets the client’s asymmetric certificate and private key from in-memory buffers. Certificate must be DER; key may be DER or PEM. Buffers are copied.
requirements: The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Must be called before a key/cert pair is already set; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
certificateNbBytes > 0 and clientCertificate != NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
keyNbBytes > 0 and clientPrivateKey != NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
Certificate buffer must contain a DER-encoded certificate; key buffer must be DER or PEM encoded.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_CreateSecureConnection
functions.signature: SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_CreateSecureConnection(const char* userDefinedId, const char* endpointUrl, OpcUa_MessageSecurityMode secuMode, SOPC_SecurityPolicy_URI secuPolicy)
functions.description: Creates and returns a new Secure Connection configuration to be completed with subsequent setters (e.g., server certificate, user auth). Owned by the library. Use it to configure and later establish a single connection.
requirements: There must be a free configuration slot; otherwise returns NULL (see SOPC_MAX_CLIENT_SECURE_CONNECTIONS_CONFIG).
endpointUrl must be a valid OPC UA URL of the form opc.tcp://<host>:<port>[/<name>].
If secuMode != None and/or secuPolicy != None, a server certificate must be provided via SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetServerCertificateFromPath/Bytes before connecting.
The returned SOPC_SecureConnection_Config is owned by the library and must not be freed by the caller.
A single connection can be established using the returned configuration via SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect.
Caller must check for a non-NULL return before proceeding.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetExpectedEndpointsDescription
functions.description: Sets an expected EndpointsDescription (from a prior GetEndpointsResponse) on the secure connection. Used to verify coherence during session activation; connection is aborted if the server’s endpoints do not match.
requirements: secConnConfig and getEndpointsResponse must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (not already used for a connection and expected endpoints not already set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The response is copied; it may be deallocated after the call.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetReverseConnection
functions.description: Enables reverse connection mode for the secure connection, configuring the client’s reverse endpoint URI used to accept reverse connections from the server.
requirements: secConnConfig and clientReverseEndpointUri must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (not already used for a connection and reverse endpoint not already set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetReqLifetime
functions.description: Sets the requested Secure Channel lifetime (in milliseconds) for key renewal. A default is used if not set.
requirements: secConnConfig must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (not already used for a connection and reverse endpoint not already set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
reqLifetime is an unsigned 32-bit millisecond value; ensure it’s within acceptable ranges for the application/server.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetServerCertificateFromPath
functions.description: Sets the server’s certificate for this secure connection from a DER file path. Required when using Sign or SignAndEncrypt security modes.
requirements: secConnConfig and serverCertPath must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (not already used for a connection and reverse endpoint not already set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The certificate file must be DER encoded and accessible at serverCertPath.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetServerCertificateFromBytes
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetServerCertificateFromBytes(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, size_t certificateNbBytes, const unsigned char* serverCertificate)
functions.description: Sets the server’s certificate for this secure connection from a DER-encoded in-memory buffer. Required when using Sign or SignAndEncrypt security modes.
requirements: secConnConfig and serverCertificate must be non-NULL, and certificateNbBytes must be > 0; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (not already used for a connection and reverse endpoint not already set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
serverCertificate must contain DER-encoded certificate bytes.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_UpdateUserPolicyId
functions.description: Uses GetEndpoints service to retrieve and set the user policy Id in the connection configuration. Useful to auto-select the correct user token policy from the server’s endpoint.
requirements: secConnConfig must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (user authentication mode must not already be set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The server must support Discovery (full none) for GetEndpoints; otherwise the operation may fail (warning in docs).
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetAnonymous
functions.description: Configures anonymous user authentication for the secure connection and sets the user token policy Id to use on the server. By default user auth is anonymous with empty policy Id.
requirements: secConnConfig and userPolicyId must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (user authentication mode must not already be set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetUserName
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetUserName(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, const char* userPolicyId, const char* userName, const char* password)
functions.description: Configures username/password user authentication for the secure connection, sets the user token policy Id, and optionally provides the username/password directly or via a previously configured callback if NULL is passed. Intended for servers requiring UserName token.
requirements: secConnConfig and userPolicyId must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
If userName or password are NULL, they must be retrievable via the callback configured with SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_SetUserNamePasswordCallback (not shown here).
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (user authentication mode must not already be set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Avoid hardcoding passwords in code as noted.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetUserX509FromPaths
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetUserX509FromPaths(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, const char* userPolicyId, const char* userCertPath, const char* userKeyPath, bool encrypted)
functions.description: Configures X509 certificate user authentication for the secure connection using certificate and key file paths, and sets the user token policy Id. Certificate must be DER; key may be DER or PEM.
requirements: secConnConfig, userPolicyId, userCertPath, and userKeyPath must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The connection config must be modifiable (user authentication mode must not already be set); otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
user certificate file must be DER-encoded; user key file must be DER or PEM.
encrypted indicates whether the key is encrypted; ensure any decryption mechanism is available if required.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetUserX509FromBytes
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetUserX509FromBytes(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, const char* userPolicyId, size_t certificateNbBytes, const unsigned char* userCertificate, size_t keyNbBytes, const unsigned char* userPrivateKey)
functions.description: Configures X509 certificate user authentication for the secure connection using in-memory buffers and sets the user token policy Id. Certificate must be DER; key may be DER or PEM. Buffers are copied.
requirements: secConnConfig and userPolicyId must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
certificateNbBytes > 0 and userCertificate != NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
keyNbBytes > 0 and userPrivateKey != NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Must be called before a key/cert pair for user auth is already set; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetServerCertUpdateCb
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_SecureConnectionConfig_SetServerCertUpdateCb(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, SOPC_KeyCertPairUpdateCb* serverCertUpdateCb, uintptr_t updateParam)
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked when the server certificate held by SOPC_CertHolder is updated at runtime via SOPC_KeyCertPair_UpdateFromBytes. Allows the application to react (e.g., revalidate or re-establish secure connection). Mandatory to set before enabling runtime certificate updates.
requirements: secConnConfig and serverCertUpdateCb must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Must be called before the connection is finalized and before a callback is already set; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
If planning to call SOPC_KeyCertPair_UpdateFromBytes at runtime, this callback must be set first (mandatory per note).
updateParam is an opaque context value passed back to the callback; ensure it remains valid for the callback’s lifetime.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientConfigHelper_GetSecureConnectionConfigs
functions.description: Retrieves the array of configured secure connection configurations and its count. Useful to iterate current connection configurations owned by the library.
requirements: nbScConfigs and scConfigArray must be non-NULL pointers; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
The client configuration wrapper must be initialized; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
The returned array and entries are owned by the library; do not free them.
Caller must check the returned SOPC_ReturnStatus and handle non-OK values.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceAsync
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceAsync(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, void* request, uintptr_t userContext)
functions.description: Send an OPC UA discovery service request (no session) and receive the response asynchronously via the globally configured async response callback. It creates/uses a transient connection for discovery traffic that remains open for further discovery calls until explicitly closed.
requirements: secConnConfig must reference a valid secure connection configuration for a discovery endpoint.
request must be an instance of one of: OpcUa_FindServersRequest, OpcUa_FindServersOnNetworkRequest, OpcUa_GetEndpointsRequest, OpcUa_RegisterServerRequest, or OpcUa_RegisterServer2Request.
request must be heap-allocated; ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
userContext will be delivered to the async response callback; if this function returns an error, the caller remains responsible for any userContext memory.
Client must be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.
If a regular (session-based) interaction is expected or endpoint is not a discovery endpoint, use the usual connection + generic services APIs instead.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceAsyncCustom
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceAsyncCustom(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, void* request, uintptr_t userContext, SOPC_ServiceAsyncResp_Fct* asyncRespCb)
functions.description: Asynchronous discovery request identical to SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceAsync but delivers the response to the provided asyncRespCb instead of the globally configured callback.
requirements: All requirements of SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceAsync apply.
asyncRespCb must be a valid function pointer; it will be invoked on response or send failure.
request must be heap-allocated; ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryAsyncCloseConnection
functions.description: Close the connection used for asynchronous discovery requests associated with the given connection configuration.
requirements: secConnConfig must be the same configuration used for prior asynchronous discovery calls.
If the same secConnConfig was also used to create a SOPC_ClientConnection, this call fails with SOPC_STATUS_WOULD_BLOCK; the expected action is to call SOPC_ClientHelper_Disconnect instead.
Client and configuration must be valid and running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE may be returned.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceSync
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_DiscoveryServiceSync(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, void* request, void** response)
functions.description: Execute a discovery request synchronously. A connection is established for the call and closed before returning. On success, response points to an encodeable response matching the request type (or ServiceFault on failure at service level).
requirements: secConnConfig must reference a valid secure connection configuration for a discovery endpoint.

request must be one of the supported discovery request types listed in the docs and must be heap-allocated; ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
response must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive an allocated encodeable object; caller owns and must free it after success (e.g., SOPC_EncodeableObject_Delete).
May return SOPC_STATUS_TIMEOUT on response timeout; may return SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if client not running.
Synchronous service calls must only be made from the application thread and NOT from client callbacks (e.g., SOPC_ServiceAsyncResp_Fct, SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent_Fct) to avoid deadlocks.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect(SOPC_SecureConnection_Config* secConnConfig, SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent_Fct* connectEventCb, SOPC_ClientConnection** secureConnection)
functions.description: Establish a secure connection (secure channel and session) synchronously using the provided configuration. On success returns a connection handle used for subsequent service calls. The event callback is used for unexpected disconnection notifications.
requirements: secConnConfig must be a valid connection configuration; only one connection can be established per given secConnConfig at a time.
connectEventCb may be NULL for now; when provided, it must not perform blocking operations; it will be used for unexpected disconnection events.
secureConnection must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the created connection handle on success.
If a connection is already established for the same secConnConfig, the function fails; call SOPC_ClientHelper_Disconnect before reconnecting.
Toolkits must be initialized and in a valid state; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Disconnect
functions.description: Synchronously disconnect and tear down a connection created by SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect. Any existing subscriptions on the connection are automatically deleted.
requirements: secureConnection must be a valid pointer to a connection handle obtained from SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect.
The pointed connection must not be in use by other operations when calling; prevent concurrent use and clear internal references before calling.
On success, *secureConnection is set to NULL and the handle must no longer be used.
If a subscription exists on the connection and was not explicitly deleted, it will be deleted automatically; the subscription pointer must not be used after this call.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsync
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsync(SOPC_ClientConnection* secureConnection, void* request, uintptr_t userContext)
functions.description: Send an OPC UA service request over an active connection and receive the response asynchronously via the globally configured async response callback.
requirements: secureConnection must be a valid, active connection obtained from SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect.

request must be a heap-allocated OPC UA request of a supported type (e.g., AddNodes, Read, Write, Browse, TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIds, GetEndpoints, FindServers, etc.); ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
userContext will be provided to the async response callback; if this function returns an error, the caller remains responsible for any userContext memory.
Client must be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsyncCustom
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsyncCustom(SOPC_ClientConnection* secureConnection, void* request, uintptr_t userContext, SOPC_ServiceAsyncResp_Fct* asyncRespCb)
functions.description: Asynchronous service request identical to SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsync but delivers the response to the provided asyncRespCb instead of the globally configured callback.
requirements: All requirements of SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceAsync apply.
asyncRespCb must be a valid function pointer; it will be invoked on response or send failure.
request must be heap-allocated; ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceSync
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_ServiceSync(SOPC_ClientConnection* secureConnection, void* request, void** response)
functions.description: Execute an OPC UA service synchronously over an active connection. On success, response points to an encodeable response matching the request type (or ServiceFault on service-level failure).
requirements: secureConnection must be a valid, active connection from SOPC_ClientHelper_Connect.

request must be a heap-allocated OPC UA request (e.g., Read, Write, Browse, TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIds, GetEndpoints, FindServers, FindServersOnNetwork, RegisterServer2, etc.); ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
response must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive an allocated encodeable object; caller must free it after success (e.g., SOPC_EncodeableObject_Delete).
May return SOPC_STATUS_TIMEOUT on response timeout; may return SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if client not running.
Synchronous service calls must only be made from the application thread and NOT from client callbacks (e.g., SOPC_ServiceAsyncResp_Fct, SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent_Fct) to avoid deadlocks.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_CreateSubscription
functions.signature: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* SOPC_ClientHelper_CreateSubscription(SOPC_ClientConnection* secureConnection, OpcUa_CreateSubscriptionRequest* subParams, SOPC_ClientSubscriptionNotification_Fct* subNotifCb, uintptr_t userParam)
functions.description: Create a subscription on the server for the given connection using the provided parameters and register a notification callback. Returns a subscription handle on success.
requirements: secureConnection must be a valid, active connection.

subParams must be a valid OpcUa_CreateSubscriptionRequest (e.g., from SOPC_CreateSubscriptionRequest_CreateDefault or Create) and must be heap-allocated; ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).

subNotifCb must be a valid function pointer and must not perform blocking operations; certain calls (e.g., Subscription_CreateMonitoredItems and Subscription_SyncService) are forbidden within this callback.
userParam is stored and retrievable via SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_GetUserParam.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_DeleteSubscription
functions.description: Delete a subscription previously created with SOPC_ClientHelper_CreateSubscription.
requirements: subscription must be a valid pointer to a subscription handle returned by SOPC_ClientHelper_CreateSubscription.
Client and subscription must be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.
On success the subscription is deleted; the pointed handle must not be used afterwards.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_SetAvailableTokens
functions.description: Configure the number of publish request tokens maintained for the connection. Each Publish response consumes one token and a new request is sent to replenish it. Default is 3.
requirements: secureConnection must be a valid, running connection.
nbPublishTokens must be greater than 0.
Client and connection must be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_GetRevisedParameters
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_GetRevisedParameters(SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* subscription, double* revisedPublishingInterval, uint32_t* revisedLifetimeCount, uint32_t* revisedMaxKeepAliveCount)
functions.description: Retrieve the server-revised subscription parameters (publishing interval, lifetime count, max keep-alive count). Any output pointer may be NULL to skip that value.
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle.
Client and connection must be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.
Output pointers are optional; provide non-NULL pointers for desired outputs.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_GetUserParam
functions.description: Return the user-supplied parameter associated with the subscription at creation time.
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_GetSecureConnection
functions.description: Return the secure connection associated with the given subscription.
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_GetSubscriptionId
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_GetSubscriptionId(const SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* subscription, uint32_t* pSubscriptionId)
functions.description: Retrieve the server-assigned SubscriptionId for the given subscription. Intended mainly for use in server method calls (e.g., ConditionRefresh).
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle.
pSubscriptionId must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the ID.
Client and connection must be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_CreateMonitoredItems
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_CreateMonitoredItems(const SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* subscription, OpcUa_CreateMonitoredItemsRequest* monitoredItemsReq, const uintptr_t* monitoredItemCtxArray, OpcUa_CreateMonitoredItemsResponse* monitoredItemsResp)
functions.description: Create monitored items on the given subscription. Optionally provide a parallel array of user contexts (one per requested item) that will be delivered with notifications, and optionally receive the server response (including results and assigned MonitoredItemIds).
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle and client must be running.

monitoredItemsReq must be a valid request; SubscriptionId and ClientHandle are ignored and set automatically; it must be heap-allocated—ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
monitoredItemCtxArray is optional; when provided, its length must match the number of items in monitoredItemsReq.
monitoredItemsResp is optional; when provided, it must point to an empty response object which will be filled and that the caller must later clear (OpcUa_CreateMonitoredItemsResponse_Clear).

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_DeleteMonitoredItems
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_DeleteMonitoredItems(const SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* subscription, OpcUa_DeleteMonitoredItemsRequest* delMonitoredItemsReq, OpcUa_DeleteMonitoredItemsResponse* delMonitoredItemsResp)
functions.description: Delete monitored items on the given subscription by server-assigned MonitoredItemIds. Optionally receive the server response with per-item results.
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle and client must be running.

delMonitoredItemsReq must be a valid request; SubscriptionId is ignored and set automatically; it must be heap-allocated—ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
delMonitoredItemsResp is optional; when provided, it must point to an empty response object which will be filled by the call.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_SyncService
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_SyncService(const SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* subscription, void* subOrMIrequest, void** subOrMIresponse)
functions.description: Execute a subscription-related service synchronously for the given subscription (excluding create/delete subscription or monitored items and transfer subscription). On success, returns a response object matching the request type (or ServiceFault on service-level failure).
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle; the subscription identifier inside the request is automatically set by this function.

subOrMIrequest must be a heap-allocated request of one of: OpcUa_ModifySubscriptionRequest, OpcUa_SetPublishingModeRequest, OpcUa_ModifyMonitoredItemsRequest, OpcUa_SetMonitoringModeRequest, or OpcUa_SetTriggeringRequest; ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
subOrMIresponse must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive an allocated encodeable object; caller must free it after success (e.g., SOPC_EncodeableObject_Delete).
Client must be running; may return SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE otherwise.
Synchronous service calls must only be made from the application thread and NOT from callbacks (e.g., SOPC_ServiceAsyncResp_Fct, SOPC_ClientConnectionEvent_Fct) to avoid deadlocks.
Do not use this function for create/delete subscription or monitored items; use dedicated APIs instead. Transfer subscription is not supported.

functions.name: SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_AsyncService
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription_AsyncService(const SOPC_ClientHelper_Subscription* subscription, void* subOrMIrequest, uintptr_t userContext)
functions.description: Execute a subscription-related service asynchronously for the given subscription (excluding create/delete subscription or monitored items and transfer subscription). Response is delivered to the globally configured async response callback.
requirements: subscription must be a valid subscription handle; the subscription identifier inside the request is automatically set by this function.

subOrMIrequest must be a heap-allocated request of one of: OpcUa_ModifySubscriptionRequest, OpcUa_SetPublishingModeRequest, OpcUa_ModifyMonitoredItemsRequest, OpcUa_SetMonitoringModeRequest, or OpcUa_SetTriggeringRequest; ownership is transferred and it must not be accessed or freed after the call (even on error).
userContext will be provided to the async response callback.
Client must be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE is returned.
Do not use this function for create/delete subscription or monitored items; use dedicated APIs instead. Transfer subscription is not supported.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes the S2OPC Server frontend configuration. Must be called before any other server configuration operation and after SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize. Sets a default logging configuration as provided by SOPC_Common_GetDefaultLogConfiguration. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE on double initialization.
requirements: Must be called after SOPC_CommonHelper_Initialize.
Must be called before any other server configuration or start operation.
Call exactly once; subsequent calls without clearing return SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Check return value for SOPC_STATUS_OK vs SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Clear
functions.description: Clears the S2OPC Server frontend configuration. Intended to be called when tearing down the server configuration, before SOPC_CommonHelper_Clear.
requirements: Should be called after a successful SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Initialize.
Must be called before SOPC_CommonHelper_Clear.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_ConfigureFromXML
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_ConfigureFromXML(const char* serverConfigPath, const char* addressSpaceConfigPath, const char* userConfigPath, SOPC_ConfigServerXML_Custom* customConfig);
functions.description: Configures the server from XML files (endpoints, address space, users credentials/rights). Can be partially used (some paths NULL) when complemented with manual configuration APIs. If S2OPC_EVENT_MANAGEMENT is enabled, event types are initialized from the address space content. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success; SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS for invalid paths or if all paths are NULL; SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started.
requirements: Toolkit must be initialized (SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Initialize) and server must not be started.
serverConfigPath should point to a file conforming to s2opc_clientserver_config.xsd when provided.
addressSpaceConfigPath should point to a file conforming to UANodeSet.xsd when provided.
userConfigPath should point to a file conforming to s2opc_clientserver_users_config.xsd when provided.
At least one of serverConfigPath, addressSpaceConfigPath, userConfigPath must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.
customConfig shall be NULL (reserved for future use).
Check and handle return values: SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetKeyPasswordCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback used to retrieve the password to decrypt the server private key. Optional; if used, must be set before starting the server and loading its configuration. The callback may be invoked during SetKeyCertPairFromPath or ConfigureFromXML. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS if the function pointer is invalid, or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started.
requirements: Must be called after server library initialization.
Must be called before starting the server and before loading server configuration.
getServerKeyPassword must be non-NULL; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS is returned.
The provided callback must allocate a zero-terminated password string on success; on failure it must free outPassword and set it to NULL.
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK vs SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS/SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetMethodCallManager
functions.description: Sets the Method Call service manager used to implement behavior of method nodes (for Call service). A default implementation can be created with SOPC_MethodCallManager_Create(). Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS if mcm is invalid, or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started.
requirements: Must be called before starting the server.
Toolkit must be initialized (server not started).
mcm must be a valid pointer to an object compliant with SOPC_MethodCallManager (from sopc_call_method_manager.h).
Caller must handle return codes SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetExternalHistoryRawReadCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback to retrieve raw history data from an external history server (ReadRaw, IsReadModified=false). Optional; requires compilation flag S2OPC_EXTERNAL_HISTORY_RAW_READ_SERVICE. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS if callback is invalid, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started, or SOPC_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED if the feature is not compiled in.
requirements: Must be called before starting the server.
Toolkit must be initialized (server not started).
S2OPC_EXTERNAL_HISTORY_RAW_READ_SERVICE must be defined at build time; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED.
rawReadCb must be non-NULL; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS.

The callback must set outStatusCode and may allocate outContinuationPoint and outDataValues (array of SOPC_DataValue) and set outNbDataValues; memory will be managed by the library after return and the callback shall not access them after return.
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE, SOPC_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetWriteNotifCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback to receive notifications of write operations on the address space. Optional; must be set before starting the server. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS if callback is invalid, or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started.
requirements: Must be called before starting the server.
Toolkit must be initialized (server not started).
writeNotifCb must be non-NULL; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS is returned.
The callback must not perform blocking or long operations, as it blocks other callbacks and service processing.
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetMonitItemNodeAvailCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback used by CreateMonitoredItems when the requested NodeId is not yet in the address space. The callback indicates whether the node should be considered known and provides its NodeClass and an initial Bad StatusCode for first notification. Optional; must be set before starting the server. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS if callback is invalid, or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started.
requirements: Must be called before starting the server.
Toolkit must be initialized (server not started).
nodeAvailCb must be non-NULL; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS is returned.
The provided callback shall not block and must return immediately.
For a given NodeId, outNodeClass shall be consistent across calls.
If the callback returns true, it must set outNodeClass and outBadStatus to an appropriate Bad status (e.g., OpcUa_BadDataUnavailable or OpcUa_BadWouldBlock).
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetLocalServiceAsyncResponse
functions.description: Registers a callback to receive asynchronous responses to local service requests sent with SOPC_ServerHelper_LocalServiceAsync. Optional (use synchronous version otherwise). Must be set before starting the server and before using the async API. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS if callback is invalid, or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started.
requirements: Must be called before starting the server and before using SOPC_ServerHelper_LocalServiceAsync.
Toolkit must be initialized (server not started).
asyncRespCb must be non-NULL; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS is returned.
The callback must not perform blocking or long operations.
The response object passed to the callback is deallocated by the caller after the call; the callback must copy/move data if it needs to keep it.
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetShutdownCountdown
functions.description: Sets the duration (in seconds) of the shutdown phase, during which the server reports state change and seconds remaining before actually stopping. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started. Default is SOPC_DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_PHASE_IN_SECONDS (5). Value 0 should not be used for OPC UA certification compliance.
requirements: Must be called before starting the server (toolkit initialized, server not started).
secondsTillShutdown is a non-negative 16-bit value; 0 is discouraged for certification compliance.
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK vs SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetCurrentTimeRefreshInterval
functions.description: Sets the refresh interval (ms) for Server.ServerStatus.CurrentTime updates. Use 0 to disable automatic updates. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_INVALID_PARAMETER if the value is less than 2*SOPC_TIMER_RESOLUTION_MS, or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started. Default is SOPC_DEFAULT_CURRENT_TIME_REFRESH_PERIOD_MS (1000 ms).
requirements: Must be called before starting the server (toolkit initialized, server not started).
intervalMs may be 0 to disable updates.
If intervalMs > 0, it must be >= 2 * SOPC_TIMER_RESOLUTION_MS; otherwise function returns SOPC_INVALID_PARAMETER.
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_INVALID_PARAMETER, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_GetLocaleIds
functions.description: Returns the configured list of server-supported locale IDs as a NULL-terminated array of strings. The returned content is read-only and must not be modified by the caller. Returns NULL on error.
requirements: Caller must treat the returned array and strings as read-only and must not modify them.
Caller must check for NULL return indicating an error.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetOverwriteRequestCb
functions.description: Registers a callback to allow the application to inspect and possibly overwrite incoming client session requests before the server processes them. Powerful and risky; the application is responsible for standard compliance and consequences. Must be set before starting the server. Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS if callback is invalid, or SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE if toolkit not initialized or server already started.
requirements: Must be called before starting the server (toolkit initialized, server not started).
overwriteReqCb must be non-NULL; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS is returned.
The callback SHALL NOT perform blocking or long operations.
If the callback modifies the request, it must manage any (de)allocation necessary for modified content.
The request->encodeableType field shall not be modified (an assertion would be triggered).
The callback should return SOPC_GoodGenericStatus to allow processing; returning other codes leads to a ServiceFault and must comply with OPC UA specification.
Caller must check return for SOPC_STATUS_OK, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetLocaleIds
functions.description: Defines the set of server locale IDs from an array of locale strings. The array and its content are copied. Typically called early in configuration, before setting application description and names per locale.
requirements: If nbLocales > 0 then localeIds must be non-NULL.
Toolkit must be initialized prior to call.
Locales must not have been already defined.
Server must not be started when calling.
Application name shall be defined for each supported locale (using SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_AddApplicationNameLocale when more than one locale is supported).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetApplicationDescription
functions.signature:
SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetApplicationDescription(const char* applicationUri,
                                                                    const char* productUri,
                                                                    const char* defaultAppName,
                                                                    const char* defaultAppNameLocale,
                                                                    OpcUa_ApplicationType applicationType)
functions.description: Sets the server application description (URIs, default localized name, and application type). Use after defining supported locales. If multiple locales are supported, add names for each with SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_AddApplicationNameLocale.
requirements: applicationUri must be valid (non-NULL, non-empty).
productUri must be valid (non-NULL, non-empty).
defaultAppName must be valid (non-NULL, non-empty).
If defaultAppNameLocale is provided, it shall exist in the supported locales set by SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetLocaleIds.
applicationType shall be one of the OpcUa_ApplicationType_*Server types.
Supported locales shall be defined prior via SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetLocaleIds.
Toolkit must be initialized; application description must not be already set; server must not be started.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_AddApplicationNameLocale
functions.signature:
SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_AddApplicationNameLocale(const char* additionalAppName,
                                                                   const char* additionalAppNameLocale)
functions.description: Adds a localized application name for a given locale to the server application description. Use when multiple locales are supported.
requirements: additionalAppName must be valid (non-NULL, non-empty).
additionalAppNameLocale must be valid (non-NULL, non-empty) and must exist in the supported locales.
Must not be called before defining the default name and locale via SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetApplicationDescription.
Toolkit must be initialized; server must not be started.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetPKIprovider
functions.description: Sets the PKI provider responsible for validating certificates received by the server. Ownership is managed by the helper and freed on SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Clear.
requirements: pki must be non-NULL and valid.
Toolkit must be initialized; a PKI provider must not already be defined; server must not be started.
Caller must not free pki after setting (it will be freed by SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Clear).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromPath
functions.signature:
SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromPath(const char* serverCertPath,
                                                                 const char* serverKeyPath,
                                                                 bool encrypted)
functions.description: Sets the server’s asymmetric certificate and private key from filesystem paths. Certificate must be DER; key may be DER or PEM. The encrypted flag indicates if the key is encrypted.
requirements: serverCertPath must be a valid non-NULL path to a DER-encoded certificate file.
serverKeyPath must be a valid non-NULL path to a DER- or PEM-encoded private key file.
encrypted must correctly reflect whether the key is encrypted (key handling is implementation-defined).
Toolkit must be initialized; key/cert pair must not already be set; server must not be started.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromBytes
functions.signature:
SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetKeyCertPairFromBytes(size_t certificateNbBytes,
                                                                  const unsigned char* serverCertificate,
                                                                  size_t keyNbBytes,
                                                                  const unsigned char* serverPrivateKey)
functions.description: Sets the server’s asymmetric certificate and private key from byte arrays. Certificate must be DER; key may be DER or PEM.
requirements: certificateNbBytes must be > 0 and serverCertificate must be non-NULL (DER-encoded).
keyNbBytes must be > 0 and serverPrivateKey must be non-NULL (DER- or PEM-encoded).
Toolkit must be initialized; key/cert pair must not already be set; server must not be started.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_CreateEndpoint
functions.description: Creates a new server endpoint configuration for the given URL, optionally enabling unsecured discovery services on the same URL. The returned configuration must be completed by adding security policies and related settings.
requirements: url must be a valid endpoint URL of the form opc.tcp://<host>:<port>[/<name>].
If hasDiscovery is true, discovery services become available without security on this endpoint.
After creation, caller should add at least one security policy via SOPC_EndpointConfig_AddSecurityConfig and complete it.
The returned pointer refers to static memory; do not free it and do not reuse once configuration is completed.
Function may return NULL if no more configuration slots are available (SOPC_MAX_ENDPOINT_DESCRIPTION_CONFIGURATIONS).
Invalid parameters or out-of-memory may trigger an assertion failure (caller must supply valid inputs).

functions.name: SOPC_EndpointConfig_AddSecurityConfig
functions.description: Adds a security policy to an endpoint configuration. The returned security configuration must be completed by setting supported security modes and user token policies.
requirements: destEndpoint must be a valid endpoint created by SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_CreateEndpoint.
uri must be a supported SOPC_SecurityPolicy_URI for the endpoint.
Returns NULL if the maximum number of security policies (SOPC_MAX_SECU_POLICIES_CFG) is reached.
The returned pointer refers to static memory; do not free it and do not reuse once configuration is completed.
After creation, caller must call SOPC_SecurityConfig_SetSecurityModes and SOPC_SecurityConfig_AddUserTokenPolicy at least once.

functions.name: SOPC_SecurityConfig_SetSecurityModes
functions.description: Sets the supported message security modes for a security configuration using a bitmask (OR of SOPC_SecurityModeMask values).
requirements: destSecuConfig must be non-NULL.
modes must be non-zero and a valid combination of SOPC_SecurityModeMask flags.
If the security policy is None, only the None mode is supported (Sign or SignAndEncrypt are not allowed for None policy).

functions.name: SOPC_SecurityConfig_AddUserTokenPolicy
functions.description: Adds a user token policy to a security configuration. Supported token policies include Anonymous, UserName_DefaultSecurityPolicy, or UserName_NoneSecurityPolicy.
requirements: destSecuConfig must be non-NULL.
userTokenPolicy must be non-NULL and one of the supported kinds (Anonymous, UserName_DefaultSecurityPolicy, or UserName_NoneSecurityPolicy).
Adding a policy may fail with SOPC_STATUS_OUT_OF_MEMORY if the maximum number of user token policies for the security policy is reached (SOPC_MAX_SECU_POLICIES_CFG).
SOPC_UserTokenPolicy_UserName_NoneSecurityPolicy shall never be used with None or Sign-only security mode to avoid possible user credential leaks.

functions.name: SOPC_EndpointConfig_AddClientToConnect
functions.signature:
bool SOPC_EndpointConfig_AddClientToConnect(SOPC_Endpoint_Config* destEndpoint,
                                            const char* clientAppUri,
                                            const char* clientEndpointUrl)
functions.description: Adds a reverse connection client configuration to a server endpoint. The server will attempt to establish a reverse connection to the given client endpoint URL (clientAppUri may be empty).
requirements: destEndpoint must be a valid endpoint created by SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_CreateEndpoint.
clientEndpointUrl must be a valid endpoint URL for the client to accept a reverse connection.
At most SOPC_MAX_REVERSE_CLIENT_CONNECTIONS can be configured; beyond that the function returns false.
Returns false on invalid parameters.

functions.name: SOPC_EndpointConfig_StopListening
functions.description: Configures the endpoint to stop listening for incoming connections; only reverse connections are allowed. Fails if no reverse connection is configured.
requirements: destEndpoint must be a valid endpoint created by SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_CreateEndpoint.
At least one reverse connection must have been configured via SOPC_EndpointConfig_AddClientToConnect prior to calling this function (otherwise returns false).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetAddressSpace
functions.description: Sets the server’s address space from a provided SOPC_AddressSpace. On success, ownership is taken and it will be deallocated on SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Clear. Only one address space can be set.
requirements: addressSpaceConfig must be a valid pointer to an initialized address space.
Only one address space can be set; subsequent calls are refused.
Toolkit must be initialized; server must not be started; address space must not already be set.
If S2OPC_EVENT_MANAGEMENT is defined, available OPC UA event types are initialized from the address space content after the call.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetUserAuthenticationManager
functions.description: Sets the user authentication manager that validates user credentials for the server. If not set, a default manager allowing any user will be instantiated.
requirements: authenticationMgr must be non-NULL.
Toolkit must be initialized; authentication manager must not already be set; server must not be started.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetUserAuthorizationManager
functions.description: Sets the user authorization manager that checks user access rights. If not set, a default manager allowing any access will be instantiated. Note: the documented INVALID_PARAMETERS clause appears to reference unrelated parameters; treat it as authorizationMgr must be valid.
requirements: authorizationMgr should be non-NULL (documentation contains a likely copy-paste error referencing other parameters; requirement inferred from function purpose).
Toolkit must be initialized; authorization manager must not already be set; server must not be started.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetSoftwareBuildInfo
functions.description: Sets the software build information displayed in the server BuildInfo node. The content is copied; the caller may clear its copy after the call.
requirements: buildInfo must be non-NULL and properly populated.
Toolkit must be initialized; build info must not already be set; server must not be started.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_GetAddressSpace
functions.description: Returns the currently configured server address space. Useful after NodeSet XML parsing to modify or extend it before the server starts.
requirements: Returns NULL if the toolkit is not initialized, the address space is not defined, or the server has already started.
Only use this to modify/extend the address space before server start. Memory ownership/validity beyond that is not documented (do not free unless specified elsewhere).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_StartServer
functions.description: Starts the OPC UA server asynchronously. Updates the Server information node and requests endpoints to open. A user-provided stopped callback is invoked when the server stops (either intentionally or due to an error such as address in use). Use after server configuration is complete. Configuration becomes frozen once started.
requirements: stoppedCb must be non-NULL (mandatory) and must not perform blocking operations (callback must be non-blocking).
The toolkit must be initialized and the server must not already be started (otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE).
Caller should wait for the stopped callback to be called after requesting stop before invoking any SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Clear function (per overall server lifecycle notes).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_StopServer
functions.description: Requests the server to stop. Behavior depends on how the server was started: when started with StartServer, this call blocks during shutdown and the configured stopped callback is invoked on actual shutdown; when started with Serve, this call is asynchronous and the server actually stops upon Serve returning. Shutdown countdown follows the configured delay to update ServerState.
requirements: The server must currently be running; otherwise returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

If the server was started with SOPC_ServerHelper_StartServer, the call blocks during shutdown and the caller is responsible to wait for the SOPC_ServerStopped_Fct to be called before using any SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Clear function.
Server shutdown follows the configured countdown (see SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetShutdownCountdown).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_Serve
functions.description: Runs the server synchronously as an alternative to StartServer: updates the Server information node, opens endpoints, and blocks until a stop is requested (StopServer or caught stop signal if enabled) or an endpoint opening error occurs.
requirements: The toolkit must be initialized and the server must not already be started (otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE).
If catchSigStop is true, the process stop signal (Ctrl+C) is caught and triggers server shutdown; server stops on the first of a stop signal or a StopServer call.
Server shutdown follows the configured countdown (see SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetShutdownCountdown).

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_LocalServiceAsync
functions.description: Asynchronously executes a local OPC UA service (read, write, browse, translate, discovery, add nodes, register server) on the running server. The response is delivered to the callback set via SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetLocalServiceAsyncResponse. Intended for local access/modification without access restrictions (only Value attribute is writable).
requirements: The server must have been started via SOPC_ServerHelper_StartServer or SOPC_ServerHelper_Serve and must still be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

request must be a heap-allocated instance of one of: OpcUa_AddNodesRequest, OpcUa_ReadRequest, OpcUa_WriteRequest, OpcUa_BrowseRequest, OpcUa_TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIdsRequest, OpcUa_GetEndpointsRequest, OpcUa_FindServersRequest, OpcUa_FindServersOnNetworkRequest, OpcUa_RegisterServer2Request.
Upon successful return, request memory is managed by the server (caller must not free it).
An asynchronous response callback must have been configured using SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetLocalServiceAsyncResponse to receive the response.
Local services are not restricted by AccessLevel; only the Value attribute is modifiable.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_LocalServiceAsyncCustom
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerHelper_LocalServiceAsyncCustom(SOPC_LocalServiceAsyncResp_Fct* asyncRespCb, void* request, uintptr_t userContext)
functions.description: Asynchronously executes a local OPC UA service like LocalServiceAsync, but delivers the response to the provided custom callback instead of the globally configured one.
requirements: The server must have been started via SOPC_ServerHelper_StartServer or SOPC_ServerHelper_Serve and must still be running (invalid state otherwise).
asyncRespCb must be non-NULL and must be suitable for being called asynchronously by the server.
request must be one of the supported OPC UA request message types listed for LocalServiceAsync.
Memory management of request after successful return follows LocalServiceAsync (managed by the server).
Local services are not restricted by AccessLevel; only the Value attribute is modifiable.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_LocalServiceSync
functions.description: Synchronously executes a local OPC UA service on the running server and returns the corresponding response object. Fails if another synchronous local service call is in progress. On service failure, the response is an OpcUa_ServiceFault.
requirements: The server must have been started via SOPC_ServerHelper_StartServer or SOPC_ServerHelper_Serve and must still be running; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.
Concurrent synchronous calls are not supported; if called concurrently, returns SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE.

request must be a heap-allocated instance of one of: OpcUa_AddNodesRequest, OpcUa_ReadRequest, OpcUa_WriteRequest, OpcUa_BrowseRequest, OpcUa_TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIdsRequest, OpcUa_GetEndpointsRequest, OpcUa_FindServersRequest, OpcUa_FindServersOnNetworkRequest, OpcUa_RegisterServer2Request.
request is freed by the S2OPC library during treatment (on success) or by the server in case of timeout; it must be heap-allocated.
response must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the allocated response object; caller is responsible for freeing the response on success.
If SOPC_HELPER_LOCAL_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS elapses before a response is provided, returns SOPC_STATUS_TIMEOUT.

Must only be called from the application thread; must not be called from server callbacks (SOPC_LocalServiceAsyncResp_Fct, SOPC_WriteNotif_Fct, SOPC_ComEvent_Fct, etc.) to avoid deadlock leading to SOPC_STATUS_TIMEOUT.
Local services are not restricted by AccessLevel; only the Value attribute is modifiable.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_CreateEvent
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerHelper_CreateEvent(const SOPC_NodeId* eventTypeId, SOPC_Event** event)
functions.description: Allocates and initializes an OPC UA event instance for the given event type NodeId. Sets a unique EventId before returning. Intended for creating events that can later be triggered. Caller owns and must free the event.
requirements: eventTypeId must reference a supported event type available in the server's address space as configured (via SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_ConfigureFromXML or SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_SetAddressSpace).
event must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the newly allocated event instance.
S2OPC must be built with event management enabled (S2OPC_EVENT_MANAGEMENT defined); otherwise SOPC_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED may be returned.
On success, caller is responsible for event deallocation.

functions.name: SOPC_ServerHelper_TriggerEvent
functions.signature: SOPC_ReturnStatus SOPC_ServerHelper_TriggerEvent(const SOPC_NodeId* notifierNodeId, SOPC_Event* event, SOPC_SessionId optSessionId, uint32_t optSubscriptionId, uint32_t optMonitoredItemId)
functions.description: Triggers (emits) the provided event from the specified notifier node. Optionally restricts delivery to a specific session, subscription, and/or monitored item. If both session and subscription are provided, the event is delivered only if the subscription belongs to that session. The event and its content are freed by the callee.
requirements: notifierNodeId must be a valid NodeId of a notifier node for the event.
event must be a valid event instance; it is automatically deallocated by the callee after the call (caller must not use or free it afterward).
optSessionId, optSubscriptionId, and optMonitoredItemId can be 0 to indicate no restriction.
When both optSessionId and optSubscriptionId are set (non-zero), the event is triggered only if the subscription is part of the given session; otherwise, it is not triggered.
Server must be in a valid state to trigger events; otherwise SOPC_STATUS_INVALID_STATE or SOPC_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED may be returned.

functions.name: SOPC_FileTransfer_Initialize
functions.description: Initializes the File Transfer module: allocates internal structures, creates the file dictionary, and registers FileType methods in the provided method-call manager. Must be paired with SOPC_FileTransfer_Clear when done.
requirements: Must be called after SOPC_ServerConfigHelper_Initialize (explicit).
Caller must later call SOPC_FileTransfer_Clear() to release resources allocated during initialization (explicit).
methodCallManager should be a valid, initialized SOPC_MethodCallManager pointer (inferred from usage).
Returns SOPC_STATUS_OK on success; otherwise an error code (explicit).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_Remove
functions.description: Removes a FileType object from the File Transfer module. The associated FileType methods stay registered in the method call manager; invocations after removal will return an error.
requirements: pFile should be a FileType instance previously created via SOPC_FileType_Create (inferred).
pFile must not be NULL (inferred).
After removal, do not use the FileType object pointer further (inferred).
Method nodes remain registered; calling those methods post-removal results in an error (explicit).

functions.name: SOPC_FileTransfer_Clear
functions.description: Clears the File Transfer module and deletes all files managed by it. Frees resources allocated by SOPC_FileTransfer_Initialize.
requirements: Must be called to release resources after SOPC_FileTransfer_Initialize (explicit).
Should not be called while FileType operations are in progress (inferred).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_Config_CreateFromNodeId
functions.signature:
SOPC_FileType_Config* SOPC_FileType_Config_CreateFromNodeId(const SOPC_NodeId* fileNodeId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* metOpenId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* metCloseId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* metReadId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* metWriteId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* metGetPosId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* metSetPosId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* varSizeId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* varOpenCountId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* varUserWritableId,
                                                            const SOPC_NodeId* varWritableId);
functions.description: Creates a FileType configuration using NodeIds of the FileType object, its methods (Open/Close/Read/Write/GetPosition/SetPosition), and variables (Size/OpenCount/UserWritable/Writable). Intended to be passed to SOPC_FileType_Create.
requirements: All NodeId pointers must reference valid existing nodes in the address space corresponding to the described elements (inferred from parameter names).
All parameters must be non-NULL (inferred).
Returned pointer is owned by the caller until passed to SOPC_FileType_Create, after which the FileTransfer module manages it (explicit via SOPC_FileType_Create note).
Returns NULL on failure (inferred from typical factory semantics).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_Config_CreateFromStringNodeId
functions.signature:
SOPC_FileType_Config* SOPC_FileType_Config_CreateFromStringNodeId(const char* fileStrNodeId,
                                                                  const char* metOpenId,
                                                                  const char* metCloseId,
                                                                  const char* metReadId,
                                                                  const char* metWriteId,
                                                                  const char* metGetPosId,
                                                                  const char* metSetPosId,
                                                                  const char* varSizeId,
                                                                  const char* varOpenCountId,
                                                                  const char* varUserWritableId,
                                                                  const char* varWritableId);
functions.description: Creates a FileType configuration from string-encoded NodeIds for the FileType object, its methods, and variables. Useful when NodeIds are provided in string form.
requirements: All string parameters must be non-NULL and must encode valid NodeIds for the corresponding elements (inferred from parameter names and brief).
Returned pointer is owned by the caller until passed to SOPC_FileType_Create, after which ownership is transferred (explicit via SOPC_FileType_Create note).
Returns NULL on failure (inferred).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_Create
functions.description: Creates a FileType object from a configuration, adds the file object to the File Transfer module, and registers the associated methods in the method-call manager.
requirements: fileConfig must be a valid configuration produced by the corresponding create functions (inferred).
After a successful call, the memory of fileConfig is managed by the FileTransfer module; the user must no longer use or free it (explicit).
Returns NULL on failure (inferred).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_GetFileNodeId
functions.description: Returns the NodeId of the given FileType object, or NULL on failure.
requirements: file must be a valid, non-NULL FileType pointer (inferred).
The returned pointer should be treated as read-only and not freed by the caller (inferred; ownership not stated).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_GetFileFromNodeId
functions.description: Looks up and returns the FileType object associated with the given file NodeId, or NULL on failure.
requirements: fileNodeId must be non-NULL and refer to a file object previously created/registered in the module (inferred).
Returned pointer is managed by the module; do not free it (inferred).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_GetMode
functions.description: Gets the current open mode (bitmask) of the specified FileType. Returns 0 if invalid or on failure.
requirements: file must be a valid, non-NULL pointer (inferred).
Interpretation of the returned bitmask follows SOPC_OpenMode semantics (inferred from typedef).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_GetHandle
functions.description: Gets the file handle generated by the server for the specified FileType. Returns 0 on failure.
requirements: file must be a valid, non-NULL pointer (inferred).
The handle is meaningful only when the file has been opened (inferred from OPC UA FileType semantics).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_GetCopyPermFileContent
functions.description: Returns a copy of the permanent file content as an SOPC_ByteString, or NULL on failure. Intended to let callers read the saved file content.
requirements: file must be a valid, non-NULL pointer (inferred).
Returned SOPC_ByteString represents a copy; ownership and freeing method are not specified in this header (unknown).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_GetCopyTmpFileContent
functions.description: Returns a copy of the temporary (in-progress) file content as an SOPC_Buffer, or NULL on failure. Useful to inspect the working buffer for the file.
requirements: file must be a valid, non-NULL pointer (inferred).
Returned SOPC_Buffer ownership and required free routine are not specified in this header (unknown).

functions.name: SOPC_FileType_SetUserOpenCb
functions.description: Registers a user callback invoked during file opening to authorize open modes and optionally supply/sync file content.
requirements: file must be a valid FileType pointer (explicit as parameter doc; inferred non-NULL).

functions.name: SOPC_UANodeSet_Parse
functions.description: Parses an OPC UA NodeSet (likely XML) from the given FILE stream and constructs an SOPC_AddressSpace instance representing the nodes and references. Typical usage: open a NodeSet file (e.g., nodeset2 XML) for reading, pass its FILE* to this function, and receive a populated address space on success. Details such as supported schema versions, ownership/lifetime of the returned object, and error reporting are not documented here and are therefore unknown.
requirements: fd must be a valid, non-NULL FILE* opened for reading (inferred from FILE* input).
The file stream should be positioned at the beginning of a valid UA NodeSet content or at the desired parse position (inferred).
The content provided via fd must be a parsable UA NodeSet; malformed or unsupported content will cause parsing to fail (inferred).
Caller should check the return value for success/failure; NULL likely indicates an error (inferred; exact error signaling is unknown).
Ownership/lifetime management of the returned SOPC_AddressSpace* is unknown; callers must consult library docs for how to free or manage it (unknown).

functions.name: SOPC_Config_Parse
functions.description: Parses an XML configuration stream compliant with the s2opc_clientserver_config.xsd schema and fills both client and server configuration data if present. Intended for loading a unified S2OPC configuration from a single XML source. Note: although the comment mentions a “Path to XML file,” the parameter type is FILE*, so callers must provide an open readable FILE* positioned at the XML content.
requirements: fd must be a valid, open FILE* for reading containing XML data.
The XML content provided via fd must comply with s2opc_clientserver_config.xsd.
config must be a non-NULL pointer to a writable SOPC_S2OPC_Config structure that will be filled by the parser.
Caller must check the boolean return value: true indicates parsing succeeded; false indicates failure.
The function reads from the current file position of fd; to parse the whole file, position the stream at the start of the XML content before calling.

functions.name: SOPC_ConfigServer_Parse

functions.name: SOPC_UsersConfig_Parse

functions.description: Parses an XML users configuration and builds corresponding user authentication and authorization manager objects. Pass a readable FILE* stream containing XML conforming to the s2opc_clientserver_users_config.xsd schema; on success, the function initializes the provided manager outputs. Note: the parameter comment mentions a file "Path" but the signature takes FILE*; treat fd as an already-opened readable stream for the XML. Use the returned managers only if the function returns true. Ownership/lifetime and specific cleanup APIs are not documented here and are unknown.
requirements: fd must not be NULL.
fd must reference a readable FILE* stream whose content is an XML document compliant with the s2opc_clientserver_users_config.xsd schema.
authentication must not be NULL and must point to a variable that can receive an output SOPC_UserAuthentication_Manager* on success.
authorization must not be NULL and must point to a variable that can receive an output SOPC_UserAuthorization_Manager* on success.
Callers must check the boolean return value; use the output manager pointers only if the function returns true.
Behavior of output parameters on failure is unspecified; callers should not assume they are initialized on false.
Resource ownership, required initialization/finalization of returned managers, and thread-safety are not documented here and are unknown.

functions.name: SOPC_Embedded_AddressSpace_LoadWithAlloc
functions.description: Load the embedded OPC UA address space described by a C structure and return a SOPC_AddressSpace handle. When allocNodes is true, nodes are allocated and copied into a modifiable address space, enabling AddNode/DeleteNode services when S2OPC_NODE_MANAGEMENT is defined. When the embedded C structure is defined as const, allocNodes is ignored (you should pass false). Returns NULL on failure. Intended for initializing the server address space at startup.
requirements: Caller must check the return value and handle NULL (load failure).
If the application intends to use AddNode/DeleteNode services, pass allocNodes = true and ensure the build defines S2OPC_NODE_MANAGEMENT.
Be aware that if the embedded C structure is defined as const, allocNodes is ignored (no node copying occurs).
Thread-safety, lifetime, and deallocation/ownership semantics of the returned SOPC_AddressSpace are unknown from this header; consult implementation/documentation.

functions.name: SOPC_Embedded_AddressSpace_Load
functions.description: Deprecated loader for the embedded OPC UA address space. It returns a SOPC_AddressSpace that directly uses the nodes from the provided C structure without copying, even if they are not const. As a consequence, AddNode/DeleteNode services are not available. Deprecated and slated for removal; equivalent behavior can be obtained with SOPC_Embedded_AddressSpace_LoadWithAlloc(false). Returns NULL on failure.
requirements: Caller must check the return value and handle NULL (load failure).
Do not rely on AddNode/DeleteNode services with the returned address space (not available).
Function is deprecated and will be removed in future releases; new code should use SOPC_Embedded_AddressSpace_LoadWithAlloc(false).
Thread-safety, lifetime, and deallocation/ownership semantics of the returned SOPC_AddressSpace are unknown from this header; consult implementation/documentation.
